English: Farewell.
Chinese: 告辞。

English: Can I ask you some questions?
Chinese: 我能问你几个问题吗？

English: Okay, I think I get it.
Chinese: 好吧，我明白了。

English: Got it.
Chinese: 明白了。

English: Actually, I had other questions.
Chinese: 其实，我还有别的问题。

English: That's all I wanted to know.
Chinese: 我想知道的就是这些。

English: I'm looking for someone.
Chinese: 我在找一个人。

English: Have you heard of the Emberian?
Chinese: 听说过余烬人吗？

English: What do you know of Vela Callose?
Chinese: 关于薇拉·卡洛斯，你知道些什么？

English: Thanks for your help.
Chinese: 多谢帮忙。

English: Ah, the [[Blinding Light.]] I remember when we captured this place from its Union ((caretakers.)) ##<<He smirks.>> Back when we thought we could get away with ((anything.))
Chinese: 啊，[[炫光要塞]]。还记得当年我们把它从联盟那帮((看门人))手里夺下来。##<<他坏笑。>>那时我们还以为天下没有((干不成))的事。

English: Was there summin' else?
Chinese: 还有什么事？

English: <<The man drums his fingers on the table as his eyes dart around. He does not look at you as he speaks.>>
Chinese: <<那人手指敲着桌面，眼珠乱转。说话时也不看你。>>

English: B'gone with you. I'm waiting for someone.
Chinese: 走吧走吧。我在等人。

English: That person is me. I'm with the Inquisition.
Chinese: 等的人就是我。我是宗教裁判所的。

English: You're Vela's Quartermaster? I've been looking for you.
Chinese: 你是薇拉的军需官？我正到处找你。

English: I'll be going, then.
Chinese: 那我先走了。

English: <<His eyes snap towards you.>> Hmm. So ((you're)) the agent? Must admit, I expected someone a little more... <<He spits.>> ((Inquisitorial.))
Chinese: <<他猛地看向你。>>嗯。所以((你))就是那个探员？不得不承认，我还以为会来个更……<<他啐了一口。>>((有宗教裁判所派头))的。

English: Looks can be deceiving.
Chinese: 人不可貌相。

English: <<He squints.>> Squidshit. I can see the marks on your wrists from the shackles. You're a ((Confessor)), aren't you? Little more than a prisoner.
Chinese: <<他眯起眼。>>放鲸屁吧。你手腕上的镣铐印我看得一清二楚。你是个((忏悔者))，对吧？跟囚犯没两样。

English: I'm a Confessor. More of a ((prisoner)) than an agent.
Chinese: 我确实是忏悔者。与其说是探员，不如说是((囚犯))。

English: <<He laughs, but his eyes stay on you.>> ##Ah, so you're with the ((Confessor Division.)) That explains it.
Chinese: <<他笑了，目光却没有离开你。>>##啊，原来你隶属((忏悔者部门))。那就说得通了。

English: I could say the same to you, old man.
Chinese: 这话送你也合适，老头。

English: <<A thin smile betrays itself.>> It's true, these old bones ache. But at least I'm a ((free man,)) eh? I can see the shackle marks on your wrists - you're not an agent. You're a ((Confessor)).
Chinese: <<一丝浅笑泄露了心思。>>没错，这把老骨头是酸疼。但至少我是个((自由人))，嗯？你手腕上的镣痕可瞒不了我——你不是什么探员。你是个((忏悔者))。

English: Those bastards - they mean to ((insult)) me, by sending one of their ((expendable rabble)). They've hunted me for years, and now they don't even deign to send an agent. ##<<He looks around.>> At least, not to my face.
Chinese: 那帮混蛋——派个((随时可弃的杂兵))来，就是想((羞辱))我。他们追了我这么多年，如今连派个正牌探员都不屑了。##<<他环顾四周。>>至少，不当着我的面派。

English: <<He hisses, teeth gritted.>> So, out with it, Confessor. Has she found it yet? Is it... ((alive?))
Chinese: <<他咬牙嘶声。>>说吧，忏悔者。她找到了吗？那东西……((还活着？))

English: Has ((who)) found it?
Chinese: ((谁))找到了？

English: ((Vela)), you inebriated ((fool!)) Who else would I be speaking of?
Chinese: ((薇拉))，你个醉醺醺的((蠢货))！我还能说谁？

English: What are you talking about?
Chinese: 你在说什么？

English: <<For a moment, he simply stares at you, brow furrowed.>>
Chinese: <<有那么一瞬，他只是皱着眉盯你。>>

English: Ach, they really haven't told you ((anything)), have they? I may as well be speaking to a silkslug. ##Do you at least know where Vela ((is))?
Chinese: 唉，他们真是什么都((没))告诉你，对吧？我还不如对着丝蛞蝓说话。##那你至少知道薇拉((在哪))吧？

English: She escaped on a sloop.
Chinese: 她乘一条单桅帆船跑了。

English: <<He nods.>> Sounds about right.
Chinese: <<他点头。>>八成是这样。

English: I tried to apprehend her, but... I failed.
Chinese: 我试图逮捕她，可是……我失败了。

English: Well of ((course)) you failed. Vela Callose, fearsome leader of the Dark Star mercenaries, against... ((you.)) Not much of a contest, eh?
Chinese: 你((当然))会失败。薇拉·卡洛斯，黑星佣兵令人胆寒的首领，对阵……((你))。这算哪门子较量，嗯？

English: She'll have gone to the [[underlands]], to rendezvous with any Dark Stars that are still loyal. ##<<He gazes out the windowpane.>> Of course, the question is ((where)). The underlands are far larger than the skyrealms; she could be anywhere...
Chinese: 她八成去了[[地下之地]]，去和她还忠心的黑星残部会合。##<<他望向窗外。>>当然，问题在((哪里))。地下之地比天空领域大得多；她可能在任何地方……

English: What are the underlands?
Chinese: 地下之地是什么？

English: <<He frowns at you.>> Surely, you jest. What are the ((underlands?)) Will you ask me about the neuron stars, next?
Chinese: <<他皱眉看你。>>你在开玩笑吧。地下之地((是什么？))你接下来是不是要问神经元星是什么？

English: No really, what are the underlands?
Chinese: 不是，真的，地下之地是什么？

English: <<His frown deepens.>> They are the lands. That are ((under.)) The skyrealms. Did they extract your mind with a hook, in that cell?
Chinese: <<他的眉头拧得更深。>>就是那些在天空领域((下面))的土地。难道他们在牢房里用钩子把你的脑子勾走了？

English: <<Seeing your blank expression, he sighs.>> When the world was destroyed in the World Rend - over four hundred years ago, now - its surface was turned into an inhospitable hellscape. ((Those)) lands are the underlands.
Chinese: <<看见你一脸茫然，他叹了口气。>>四百多年前，世界撕裂毁了整个世界——地表从此变成一片不宜栖居的炼狱。((那))片土地就是地下之地。

English: Uh, what's a neuron star?
Chinese: 呃，神经元星是什么？

English: So the Inquisition seek to mock me by sending an imbecile, is that right? Well, I won't lower myself to your foolishness.
Chinese: 所以宗教裁判所派个白痴来是要羞辱我，是这意思吧？哼，我才不陪你犯蠢。

English: Yes, a... fine jest. Let's move on.
Chinese: 对，是个……好笑话。我们继续吧。

English: <<He nods, still frowning.>>
Chinese: <<他点头，眉头仍锁着。>>

English: How do you know Vela's gone there?
Chinese: 你怎么知道薇拉去了那里？

English: She hunts something there - she has done, for years. Something... of terrible power.
Chinese: 她在那里猎取一样东西——很多年了。一样……力量骇人的东西。

English: I can't tell you ((exactly)) what it is. Only that she plans to use it to meddle with ((reality itself)), which could be the doom of us all.
Chinese: 我没法((确切))告诉你那是什么。只知道她打算用它摆弄((现实本身))，而那可能给我们所有人带来灭顶之灾。

English: So, you'll help me find Vela?
Chinese: 所以，你会帮我找薇拉？

English: That's the deal that I've struck with your ((Inquisition)), isn't it? Hunt my former comrade - and my Dark Star crewmates - for the Polymath's Pardon. After this, I'll be a traitor to ((everyone)).
Chinese: 这不就是我和你们((宗教裁判所))谈好的交易嘛？去追捕我的旧战友——还有我的黑星船员们——换一纸博学家赦令。此事过后，我就成了((所有人))的叛徒。

English: <<He sighs, leaning back.>> Well then, Confessor. We may as well get to know each other. What did you... <<He waves his hand around. >> ((do)), before rotting in a cell?
Chinese: <<他往后一靠，叹了口气。>>那么，忏悔者，咱们不妨互相认识认识。你在牢里发霉之前……<<他挥了挥手。>>是((干))什么的？

English: I was a soldier.
Chinese: 我当过兵。

English: Hmph, a regular grunt of the battlefield, eh? No doubt you've seen your fair share of spilled blood, all in the service of some foppish Union lord.
Chinese: 哼，战场上的一介小兵，嗯？为了某个花天酒地的联盟老爷，血你肯定没少洒。

English: I was a mercenary.
Chinese: 我当过佣兵。

English: Ah, a cutthroat after my own heart. The nobles in Riova can preach their drivel of ((honour)) and ((unity)), but we both know that in the end, it's the coin in one's purse that gets you through.
Chinese: 啊，跟我一路的杀手。里奥瓦的贵族尽管去宣讲他们的((荣誉))与((团结))的鬼话，但你我都知道，到最后能保命的，是钱袋里的硬币。

English: I was an inquisitor.
Chinese: 我当过审判官。

English: <<He squints at you.>> So you really ((were)) an agent, eh? Hah! Betrayed and brought low by your masters. Tell me: did you savour, in that damp cell, the ((irony)) of your entrapment?
Chinese: <<他眯眼打量你。>>这么说你((真))当过探员，嗯？哈！被自己的主子出卖、打落尘埃。告诉我：在那间阴湿的牢房里，你可曾细品过自己这番遭遇的((讽刺))？

English: I was an assassin.
Chinese: 我当过刺客。

English: <<He squints at you.>> So you're one to keep an eye on, eh? I'll admit, even when we've been forced to use your kind, I've had no love for ((that)) profession. To kill a man while he sleeps - there's no decency in that.
Chinese: <<他眯眼打量你。>>这么说你这种人得留神提防，嗯？不得不承认，就算被逼无奈雇过你们这类人，我也从没喜欢过((那一))行。趁人睡觉时下杀手——那不是正经人干的事。

English: I was hired muscle.
Chinese: 我当过打手。

English: I see. Probably running drugs and potions for the cartels, correct? Or cracking some skulls when money's due? Not that I can judge; we had plenty of contacts in your line of work.
Chinese: 明白了。多半是替卡特尔跑毒品和药水，对吧？或者到了收账的日子就去砸人脑袋？不是我要评判你；你这一行里我们的老相识多着呢。

English: I was a thief.
Chinese: 我当过小偷。

English: Not an easy life, eh? Of course, we hear tales of those who lift treasures with ease and disappear into the night - but more often it's broken teeth and a month in the cells, correct? Yes, you know that all too well, I can see.
Chinese: 不好过的营生，嗯？当然，我们也听过那些妙手空空、消失于夜色的传说——但更常见的是磕掉牙、蹲一个月大牢，对吧？没错，你太清楚了，我看得出来。

English: I was a lore broker.
Chinese: 我当过秘闻掮客。

English: A keeper of secrets? Interesting. When work was scarce, we'd often go plundering ancient and dark places -and we'd always be sure to bring one of ((your kind)) along.
Chinese: 守护秘密的人？有意思。活计不顺的时候，我们常去劫掠古老幽暗之地——而且总会带上一个((你这种))人。

English: I was a fixer.
Chinese: 我当过中间人。

English: Knowledge is ((power)), indeed. You're a good person to know, that's for sure. There's been many a time when a whisper here, or a tip-off there, has been more useful than a galleon full of cannons.
Chinese: 知识就是((力量))，诚然。结识你这种人准没错。多少回，这里一句耳语、那里一条线报，比一整船大炮都管用。

English: I was an adventurer.
Chinese: 我当过冒险家。

English: Ah, a free spirit - how ((delightful.)) It must be nice to set off alone, going where the wind takes you, eh? Of course, I've known plenty who've done just that, and ended up clutching their spilled guts in a ditch somewhere. I reckon you should count yourself lucky.
Chinese: 啊，自由之魂——真((令人羡慕。))独自上路、随遇而安，想必很惬意，嗯？当然，这么干的人我见得多了，最后都在哪条沟里抱着自己流出来的肠子咽气。我看你还是该庆幸自己命大。

English: I was an aetherist.
Chinese: 我当过乙太师。

English: A scholar of the cosmos? I must admit, your kind has always fascinated me. That someone would strap together a bunch of wood, weave it with a spell, and let it carry them into the endless void? What bravado! What ((stupidity!))
Chinese: 研究宇宙的学者？不得不承认，你们这类人一直让我着迷。把一堆木板捆起来、织上法术，就敢让它载着自己冲进无尽虚空？好大的胆魄！好大的((蠢劲！))

English: I was a scholar.
Chinese: 我当过学者。

English: Ah, happier behind a desk than wielding a sword, are you? There's no shame in that. And I suppose those books are quite heavy; if you find yourself in a scrape, you can always bludgeon someone to death with one, no?
Chinese: 啊，比起舞刀弄剑，还是伏案更自在，是吧？这没什么可丢人的。再说那些书想必挺沉；万一遇上麻烦，随手抄一本就能把人砸死，不是吗？

English: I was a politician.
Chinese: 我当过政客。

English: I must say, I've no love for those who hide behind petty arguments and legal nonsense. I've been to Riova more times than I care for, and each time I'd rather have been in a den of drunken brigands.
Chinese: 不瞒你说，我就看不上那些躲在鸡毛蒜皮的争辩和法律废话后面的人。里奥瓦我去过太多不想再数的次数，每一回都宁愿自己在醉醺醺的匪窝里待着。

English: I was a battle-councillor.
Chinese: 我当过战议员。

English: Ah, so you fought in election campaigns? More gruelling than any of the military sort, I'd wager. Saw one in Byonne, once; the losing party was cut into bloody pieces. All they wanted was better tax levies.
Chinese: 啊，所以你打过选战？我敢说，那比任何真刀真枪的仗都熬人。在拜昂见过一回；落选一方被剁成了血块。他们图的不过是减点税。

English: I was a noble, then... a thief.
Chinese: 我当过贵族，后来……当了小偷。

English: Ah, fell on hard times, did we? Privilege can crumble into poverty without a moment's notice. At least you had the wits to make the best of it.
Chinese: 啊，家道中落了，是吧？荣华富贵说塌就塌。至少你还有脑子随机应变。

English: I was an occultist.
Chinese: 我当过秘术师。

English: <<He grins.>> An occultist, under Inquisition employ? Now I really ((have)) heard it all. I'm surprised they didn't gouge out your eyes for exchanging niceties with a garden spirit.
Chinese: <<他咧嘴笑。>>秘术师，还受宗教裁判所雇用？这下我可真是((闻所未闻))了。他们没因为你跟个园圃精灵寒暄就把你眼珠挖出来，算你运气好。

English: I was a socialite.
Chinese: 我当过社交名流。

English: Ah, a hard day's work was ((beneath)) you, was it? Well, looks like the tables have certainly turned. Bet that silver tongue didn't serve much good in that damp cell now, did it?
Chinese: 啊，一天到晚干力气活有((失))你的身份，是吧？哼，如今风水轮流转了吧。我打赌你那条三寸不烂之舌，在那间阴湿牢房里没帮上什么忙，对吧？

English: Anyway, it doesn't matter now, eh? You've lost it all. Hit rock bottom. ((That's)) something I can respect. <<He smirks, and raises his drink to you.>>
Chinese: 算了，如今都无所谓了，嗯？你失去了一切。跌到了谷底。((这))倒让我敬佩。<<他坏笑着朝你举杯。>>

English: I'd rather not say.
Chinese: 我不想说。

English: Like to keep your cards close to your chest, eh? I can respect that. Shows you've got some wits, at least.
Chinese: 喜欢把底牌捂在胸口，嗯？这个我敬重。至少说明你有点脑子。

English: As for myself, my name is Jack Basalt. I suppose you've heard of me. <<He takes a sip from his tankard.>>
Chinese: 至于我，我叫杰克·巴索特。你应该听说过我。<<他端起酒杯抿了一口。>>

English: I've not heard of you, no.
Chinese: 还真没听说过你。

English: <<He chokes on his drink, sputtering.>>##Well, I... I guess not ((everyone)) has heard the stories, eh?
Chinese: <<他被酒呛住，咳了半天。>>##呃，我……我猜不是((人人))都听过那些故事，嗯？

English: Captain Basalt? The shame of the Union Navy...
Chinese: 巴索特船长？联盟海军之耻……

English: Aye, the one and same.
Chinese: 正是，如假包换。

English: Does it matter?
Chinese: 这重要吗？

English: The name? I suppose not. ##But if we're going to tracking down Vela, you should know a thing or two.
Chinese: 名字？大概不重要。##不过既然要一起追查薇拉，你该了解点底细。

English: For a time, I was the most respected captain in the Union Navy. I took orders directly from [[Admiral Callose]] - ((Vela's father.)) ##And for five years, I trained Vela aboard my ship.
Chinese: 曾几何时，我是联盟海军最负盛名的船长。我直接听命于[[卡洛斯将军]]——((薇拉的父亲。))##有五年之久，我在自己的船上训练薇拉。

English: When Vela defied her father and fled to become a mercenary - I followed. I gave up my rank, my station, my ((ship)), to spend my years cavorting with Wikkans and pirates. ((Shame)) of the Union Navy, they branded me...
Chinese: 薇拉违逆父亲、出逃当了佣兵——我追随而去。我抛下军衔、职位、((战舰))，此后多年与维坎教团和海盗厮混。他们给我扣上了联盟海军((之耻))的帽子……

English: <<He stares down, into his drink.>>##But I kept her ((safe)). Was that not ((also)) my duty?
Chinese: <<他低头盯着酒杯。>>##可我把她((护))住了。那难道不((也))是我的职责吗？

English: So you ((trained)) Vela?
Chinese: 所以薇拉是你((训练))的？

English: Aye, Vela and...the Emberian. Though they'd been schooled at the Academy, their father wanted 'em to sling their hammocks and tie their knots like regular sea dogs.
Chinese: 是啊，薇拉还有……余烬人。虽然她们在学院受过教育，她们父亲偏要她们像普通水手一样吊吊床、打绳结。

English: And so they did; through blizzards, cipher storms and cannon volleys. Those sisters thrived, until... ##until the ((Dyshaan massacre.))
Chinese: 她们也确实做到了；熬过暴风雪、密文风暴和炮火齐射。这对姐妹出落得愈发优秀，直到……##直到((迪尚屠杀))。

English: <<He thumbs the rim of his drink.>> I won't speak of that here. Not here. But that was the day Vela decided to leave the navy, an' her father. That was the day we became mercenaries.
Chinese: <<他摩挲着杯沿。>>这事我不在这儿讲。不在这儿。但那一天，薇拉决意离开海军，离开她父亲。那一天，我们成了佣兵。

English: So why are you hunting her?
Chinese: 那你为什么要追捕她？

English: You have to understand, I love that girl like she's my own. I've seen her grow from a headstrong child into a fierce captain, and there was a time - when we were sailing together as Dark Stars - when I thought she might be the ((greatest)) of 'em all.
Chinese: 你要明白，我爱那个女孩如亲生的。我看着她从倔强的孩子成长为凶悍的船长，曾几何时——我们还在黑星旗下并肩航行时——我以为她会是所有人里((最了不起))的那一个。

English: So, to see her fall into barbarism and villainy... has been ((hard)). I can't abide by what she's done, or by what she ((will do)). She seeks to save us, but she'll likely ((doom)) us.
Chinese: 所以，眼看她堕入野蛮与邪恶……实在((煎熬))。她做过的事，她((将做))的事，我都无法容忍。她自认为在拯救我们，可她多半会((葬送))我们。

English: So I have to stop her, you see? For her ((own)) sake.
Chinese: 所以我必须拦住她，明白吗？为了她((自己))好。

English: Right, so how will we find Vela?
Chinese: 好，那我们怎么找到薇拉？

English: Hah, you're asking ((me))? As I said to your masters, I can provide naught but shreds of information. You'll have to do the rest.
Chinese: 哈，你问((我))？跟你主子们说的一样，我能给的只有零星情报。剩下的得靠你自己。

English: What I have for you are [[three names]]. Names of former Dark Star mercenaries, who left Vela's crew after [[the mutiny]]. Together, maybe the lot of us can track her down.
Chinese: 我能给你的，是[[三个名字]]。都是前黑星佣兵，在[[哗变]]之后离开了薇拉的船队。我们几个联手，也许能追到她。

English: What's this about a mutiny?
Chinese: 哗变是怎么回事？

English: Few years back, Vela found a map. A map that pointed to something... ((impossible)).
Chinese: 几年前，薇拉找到一张地图。一张指向……((不可能之物))的地图。

English: She'd use it to make a ((heaven)) of the skyrealms, she said. Change the fabric of reality, so folk don't know poverty, or injustice - or even ((death.))
Chinese: 她说，她要用它把天空领域变成((天堂))。改写现实的肌理，让人间不再有贫穷、不公——甚至不再有((死亡。))

English: I'm sure she believed it. Believes it ((still)). But for a lot of us Dark Stars, it scared us witless. You just don't go ((meddling)) with things like that - 'less you wanna die screaming.
Chinese: 我确信她信了。((现在))也信。但对我们许多黑星来说，这把我们吓得魂飞魄散。那种东西((碰))不得——除非你想死得惨叫连连。

English: We tried to convince her - to make her see reason. But she took us down into the underlands anyway, on that mad pursuit... ##So we mutinied, and the Dark Stars spilled their own blood on those skyships.
Chinese: 我们试着劝她——让她讲点道理。可她还是带着我们一头扎进地下之地，踏上那场疯狂的追逐……##于是我们哗变了，黑星的血洒在了自己的飞艇甲板上。

English: In the end, Vela escaped with those loyal to her; and the rest of us scattered to lick our wounds. A wicked time, that was.
Chinese: 最后，薇拉带着忠于她的人逃了；我们其余人四散而去，各自舔舐伤口。那是一段邪性的岁月。

English: Okay, tell me about these mercenaries.
Chinese: 好，给我讲讲这几个佣兵。

English: First, there's the [[Emberian]]. Called that, 'cos folk say she's the ((last)) of their kind. Of course, that's pure squidshit - if she was Emberian she'd be four hundred years old. I've heard talk she's somewhere in [[Hallowshire.]]
Chinese: 头一个，[[余烬人]]。这么叫她，是因为人们说她是那个族群((最后))的血脉。当然，纯属鲸屁——她真是余烬人的话就四百岁了。听说她就在[[哈洛郡]]某处。

English: Next there's the [[Endless Duchess]], a powerful cipher wizard. She went back to her ancestral home in the [[Endless Realm]] - and like all those you'll find there, she's cursed to never truly die. ##<<He smirks.>> Which means ((she)) really ((is)) hundreds of years old.
Chinese: 其次是[[无尽女公爵]]，一位强大的密文法师。她回了[[无尽领域]]的祖宅——和那里的所有同类一样，她受着永不真死的诅咒。##<<他坏笑。>>也就是说，((她))((真的))有好几百岁了。

English: Finally, there's [[Caxton Frost]]. A genius of the [[Clockwork Kingdom]]; that man could engineer a skyship from a sack of junk. Last I heard, he'd returned to his homeland.
Chinese: 最后是[[卡克斯顿·弗罗斯特]]。[[发条王国]]的天才；那家伙能用一麻袋破烂造出一艘飞艇。据我上次听说，他回了老家。

English: And you're sure they'll help us?
Chinese: 你确定他们会帮我们？

English: Am I ((sure)) they'll follow you to their certain deaths? Of course not, you fool! They'll probably try and cut your head off.
Chinese: 我((确定))他们会跟着你去送死？当然不确定，你这蠢货！他们八成会想砍下你的脑袋。

English: But if you want to find Vela, you're just going to have to ((ask nicely.))
Chinese: 但你既然要找薇拉，就只好((好声好气地求))了。

English: And if they ((do)) agree?
Chinese: 那要是他们((真))答应了呢？

English: Got it.
Chinese: 明白了。

English: You lot must have captured Vela's Fortress, the [[Blinding Light]] - correct? I heard the cannon fire from here. ##Tell you what, I'll head there myself, after this little chat. And if you find any of those Dark Stars? Send 'em there and all.
Chinese: 你们应该已经拿下了薇拉的堡垒，[[炫光要塞]]——对吧？炮声我在这儿都听见了。##这么着，聊完这点事我就自己过去。要是你找到了那些黑星，也都往那儿送。

English: <<He affixes you with a grim stare.>> And that ((thing)) Vela's looking for?
Chinese: <<他阴沉地瞪着你。>>还有薇拉在找的那((东西))呢？

English: She mustn't use it. Nobody must ((ever)) use it. You hear me? If you've any sense, you'll make sure it stays ((buried)) down there.
Chinese: 她不能用它。谁都((永远))不能用它。听见没？你但凡还有点脑子，就该确保它永远((埋))在下面。

English: <<He shifts, suddenly nervous.>> Right. Well I think we're done here.
Chinese: <<他扭了扭身子，突然紧张起来。>>行了。我看就到这儿吧。

English: Can I ask you about something?
Chinese: 我能问你点事吗？

English: And what might that be?
Chinese: 什么事？

English: About the Dark Stars I'm looking for...
Chinese: 关于我要找的那些黑星……

English: Right. You want to hear some more info?
Chinese: 行。想再听点情报？

English: Tell me more about the Emberian.
Chinese: 再多讲讲余烬人。

English: The Emberian - that's what people call her, but I knew her as [[Orlaith]]. She's been close to Vela for years, and is one of the few who can match her with a blade.
Chinese: 余烬人——人们这么叫她，而我认识她时她叫[[奥莱丝]]。她与薇拉相交多年，是寥寥几个能用刀剑跟她过上几招的人之一。

English: She was one of the first of the Dark Stars. Time was, it was just me, Vela and Orlaith, setting out on a wobbly sloop. By the end, Orlaith was captain of the [[SHIP]], and second only to Vela.
Chinese: 她是最早一批黑星。想当年，船上就我、薇拉和奥莱丝三个人，开一条晃晃悠悠的单桅帆船闯天下。到后来，奥莱丝已是[[SHIP]]的船长，地位仅次于薇拉。

English: She wears an ancient suit o' Emberian armour, and on account of that, folk like to say ((she's)) four hundred years old, too. Of course, that's a load of nonsense...
Chinese: 她穿着一套古余烬铠甲，因此人们爱说她((也))有四百岁。当然，纯属一派胡言……

English: After the mutiny, she set out on her own. I heard whispers she set up camp somewhere in [[Hallowshire]], but I can't tell you any more than that.
Chinese: 哗变之后，她就单飞了。有风声说她把营地扎在了[[哈洛郡]]某处，但我也只知道这么多。

English: Tell me more about the Endless Duchess.
Chinese: 再多讲讲无尽女公爵。

English: The [[Endless Duchess]] - she's a powerful cipher wizard. She went back to her ancestral home in the [[Endless Realm]] - and like all those you'll find there, she's cursed to never truly die.
Chinese: [[无尽女公爵]]——一位强大的密文法师。她回了[[无尽领域]]的祖宅——和那里的所有同类一样，她受着永不真死的诅咒。

English: Tell me more about Caxton Frost.
Chinese: 再多讲讲卡克斯顿·弗罗斯特。

English: Frost called himself a 'techno-archaeologist' - and if you laughed at that, he'd teach you a brutal lesson. That's why we dubbed him the Professor.
Chinese: 弗罗斯特自称"科技考古学家"——你要是笑出声，他能给你上一堂惨痛的课。所以我们给他起了个绰号，叫教授。

English: The man always was an odd fish. Distant, melancholy. You never could quite tell what he was thinking. But no one knew more than him about ancient Emberian machines - or modern ones, for that matter.
Chinese: 那人向来是个怪家伙。疏离，阴郁。你永远猜不透他在想什么。但论古余烬机械的学问——现代机械也一样——没人比得上他。

English: As for how to find him... well, he talks like a posh prat, but swears like a sailor. Doesn't suffer fools gladly, or at all. Has [[trouble walking]].##Oh, and he has a [[moth tattoo]] on his left arse cheek.
Chinese: 至于怎么认出他……这么说吧，他说话像个上流蠢货，骂起人来却像水手。最见不得蠢人，压根见不得。走路[[不利索]]。##哦对了，他左边屁股蛋上有个[[飞蛾刺青]]。

English: Now, word on the Dark Star grapevine is that Frost is dead. Two crewmates saw him jump overboard one night, in open sky. Afterward they found a note. He sided with Vela in the mutiny, see, and couldn't get over what he'd done.
Chinese: 眼下黑星小道消息说，弗罗斯特死了。两个船员看见他某天夜里在茫茫天空中跳下了船。事后他们找到一张字条。哗变时他站在薇拉那边，你明白吧，他过不去自己那道坎。

English: But me? Nah. I won't believe it until I've stubbed out my own cigar in his cold dead eye. ##Frost always was a patriot at heart. If he's alive, odds are he's back in the [[Clockwork Kingdom]].
Chinese: 但我信吗？不信。除非我能把雪茄摁灭在他冰冷的死鱼眼里，否则我不信。##弗罗斯特骨子里一直是个爱国者。他要是还活着，八成回了[[发条王国]]。

English: How do you know about his tattoo?
Chinese: 他的刺青你怎么知道的？

English: <<Basalt smirks.>> I'll leave that to your imagination, Confessor.
Chinese: <<巴索特坏笑。>>这就留给你自己想象了，忏悔者。

English: Thanks for the intelligence.
Chinese: 多谢情报。

English: That's all.
Chinese: 就这些。

English: Alright, then.
Chinese: 好嘞。

English: About your past...
Chinese: 关于你的过去……

English: Hmph, dredging that up, are we?
Chinese: 哼，要翻旧账了是吧？

English: Tell me of your time as a Captain.
Chinese: 讲讲你当船长的那段日子。

English: Tell me of the Dark Star mutiny.
Chinese: 讲讲黑星哗变。

English: About Vela Callose...
Chinese: 关于薇拉·卡洛斯……

English: What about her?
Chinese: 她怎么了？

English: So you ((trained)) Vela?
Chinese: 所以薇拉是你((训练))的？

English: Why are you hunting her?
Chinese: 你为什么要追捕她？

English: What's she looking for, in the underlands?
Chinese: 她在地下之地找什么？

English: About something else...
Chinese: 关于别的……

English: And what's that, now?
Chinese: 又是什么事？

English: Okay, that's all. I'll get going.
Chinese: 好，就这些。我先走了。

English: Right. I'll be at the [[Blinding Light]].
Chinese: 好。我会在[[炫光要塞]]。

English: Only... something tells me you won't be able to find them just yet. Call it a hunch.
Chinese: 只是……我有个直觉，你现在还找不齐他们。就叫直觉吧。

English: Ah, the [[Blinding Light.]] I remember when we captured this place from its Union ((caretakers.)) ##<<He smirks.>> Back when we thought we could get away with ((anything.))
Chinese: 啊，[[炫光要塞]]。还记得当年我们把它从联盟那帮((看门人))手里夺下来。##<<他坏笑。>>那时我们还以为天下没有((干不成))的事。

English: Alright. I'll be 'ere if you need me.
Chinese: 好嘞。有事就来这儿找我。

English: Right y'are. Anythin' else?
Chinese: 好嘞。还有别的事吗？

English: <<He nods.>> Confessor.  ##What can I do for you?
Chinese: <<他点头。>>忏悔者。##有何贵干？

English: What do you know of Vela Callose?
Chinese: 关于薇拉·卡洛斯，你知道些什么？

English: Oh. An' who might that be?
Chinese: 哦。那是何方神圣？

English: <<He chuckles.>> What kind o' innkeep do you take me for? I've heard more stories 'bout Vela than I can recount...
Chinese: <<他轻笑。>>你当我是哪种掌柜的？薇拉的故事我听过的多得数不过来……

English: Her Dark Star mercenaries fought in the Slevian Mutiny, the Battle of Weeping Wizards, an' on ((both sides)) of the Wikkan uprising of Hawkney. They've taken coin from Riovan councillors and occultist villages alike..
Chinese: 她手下的黑星佣兵打过斯列夫兵变、泣泪法师会战，霍克尼维坎起义时((两边))都收过他们的钱。里奥瓦议员的钱他们收过，秘术师村落的钱他们也收过……

English: <<He leans on the bar.>>##And when folk ain't been spilling each other's blood, they've gone a' plundering; Emberian ruins, Wikkan shrines... An' you know the tomb of the Deathless Dynast King? That was ((them)) that stole his face.
Chinese: <<他倚在吧台上。>>##不流人人相残的血时，他们就出门劫掠；余烬遗迹、维坎神龛……你知道不朽王朝王的陵墓吗？把他脸偷走的就是((他们))。

English: <<He leans in so close, you can smell his breath.>>##Some folk say she's a saint, who's gonna right the wrongs of the Union. Others say she's a ((devil)), who leaves a path of chaos in her wake. But you know what?
Chinese: <<他凑得极近，你都能闻到他嘴里的酒气。>>##有人说她是圣徒，要来匡正联盟的种种不义。也有人说她是((恶魔))，走到哪儿就祸乱到哪儿。可你知道吗？

English: <<He jabs the table, eyes wide.>>##She were 'ere, once. Two years ago, her and a load of her crew. They kicked everyone else out; must'a been ((fifty)) of the sods, getting pissed as skyfish.
Chinese: <<他戳着桌子，眼睛瞪圆。>>##她来过这儿。两年前，她带着一大帮船员。他们把旁人全轰了出去；足有((五十))号混账东西，一个个醉得像天上的鱼。

English: An' I saw that she weren't no saint. She weren't no devil. She were...
Chinese: 我算是看清了，她不是圣徒。也不是恶魔。她是……

English: ((Completely shitfaced.))
Chinese: ((烂醉如泥。))

English: <<He guffaws, wiping a tear from his face.>> I ((did)) warn her about that typhos rum. We made more coin that night than most weeks, I reckon.
Chinese: <<他放声大笑，抹掉眼角的泪。>>那提福斯朗姆酒我((可))提醒过她。那晚我们挣的硬币，比平常几个星期都多，我估摸着。

English: Thanks for your help.
Chinese: 多谢帮忙。

English: Don't be mentionin' it.
Chinese: 别客气。

English: I'm looking for someone. Goes by the ((Emberian))...
Chinese: 我在找一个人。外号叫((余烬人))……

English: <<He furrows his brow.>> Oh, aye? And who's askin'?
Chinese: <<他皱起眉头。>>哦，是吗？哪位在打听？

English: I'm with the Inquisition.
Chinese: 我是宗教裁判所的人。

English: <<His frown contorts further.>> Listen, stranger. Folk round 'ere don't take too ((kindly)) to the mention of... ((those)) lot.
Chinese: <<他的眉头拧得更紧。>>听着，外乡人。这一带的人听到有人提起……((那帮人))，心里可((痛快))不了。

English: Usually, when the Union's lapdogs come a'callin', it happens quick and it happens brutal. Spilled drinks, broken noses - and someone gets dragged out screaming.
Chinese: 通常联盟的走狗一登门，事情就来得又快又狠。酒水泼洒、鼻梁打断——总有人被拖出去时一路惨叫。

English: And you sure don't ((look)) like one o' their agents. So I'll say again - ((who's asking?))
Chinese: 再说你看上去也((不像))他们的探员。所以我再问一遍——((你哪位？))

English: I'm serious. I'm with the inquisition.
Chinese: 我是认真的。我真的属于宗教裁判所。

English: <<He stares at you for a good few moments.>> Well. I'm not saying I believe you. But...
Chinese: <<他盯着你看了好一阵。>>嗯。我不是说信了你。不过……

English: I'm just curious whether the stories are true.
Chinese: 我只是好奇那些故事是不是真的。

English: Humph. Folk sure do like to wag their chins around here...
Chinese: 哼。这一带的人还真爱嚼舌头……

English: Every now an' then, for the past year or so, we've had a lass in huge rusty armour stop by.
Chinese: 过去一年左右，时不时有个穿着一身大锈甲的姑娘来店里歇脚。

English: Soon as she slams open that door, folk go quiet. Perhaps it's her moody stare, or perhaps it's that greatsword that's bigger than ((her))...
Chinese: 她一踹开那扇门，满堂立马鸦雀无声。也许是她阴沉的注视，也许是那把比她((人))还大的巨剑……

English: Or perhaps it's the stories. Y'see, people say that she used to run with Vela's crew - the ((Dark Stars)). ##They say she was a captain of one 'o their ships, and wore a full suit of ancient Emberian armour...
Chinese: 又或者，是那些传闻。你想，人们说她从前跟过薇拉的船队——((黑星))。##据说她当过他们一条船的船长，还穿着一整套古老的余烬铠甲……

English: But folk say it's not just the ((armour)) that's Emberian. They say that ((she's)) been walking the skyrealms ever since the World Rend, wandering for ((hundreds of years...))
Chinese: 可人们说，不光那身((铠甲))是余烬的。他们说((她本人))从世界撕裂起就在天空领域行走，游荡了((几百年……))

English: <<He chuckles.>> But, folk say a lot of things, don't they?
Chinese: <<他轻笑。>>不过，人们嘴上什么都说，不是吗？

English: Do you know where to find her?
Chinese: 你知道去哪找她吗？

English: Some say she lives in a castle. Others, a dank cave. But I don't think anyone's ever actually gone an' ((asked)) her...
Chinese: 有人说她住城堡，有人说她住阴湿的洞穴。但我想还真没人上去((问过))她本人……

English: But y'know what? She often comes in all muddy an' smelling of thornweed. So, I'd wager it'd be somewhere in the [[forest to the west...]]
Chinese: 不过你知道吗？她每次来都是一身泥、带着荆棘草味。所以我赌她窝在[[西边的森林里……]]

English: Thanks for the info.
Chinese: 多谢指点。

English: Well, just keep it between us, y'hear? Don't want that lass on my bad side...
Chinese: 嗯，这些话别外传，听见没？可不想惹那位姑娘记恨……

English: O' course. What ye be wantin'?
Chinese: 好嘞。你想要点什么？

English: Now, will there be anythin' else?
Chinese: 那么，还要点别的吗？

English: I'm looking for someone.
Chinese: 我在找一个人。

English: Oh? Well I can certainly try and be of assistance.
Chinese: 哦？那我一定尽力效劳。

English: Have you heard of the Emberian?
Chinese: 听说过余烬人吗？

English: Ah, why yes, I have. She's quite the talk of the town; many people have seen her striding around in that antique armour.
Chinese: 啊，没错，听说过。她可是镇上的热门话题；好些人都见过她穿着那身古董铠甲昂首阔步。

English: In fact, she came by this shop, not too long ago. I tried to determine where she obtained that Emberian equipment of hers, but she was very tight-lipped about it.
Chinese: 其实不久前她还来过本店。我想打听她那身余烬装备的来路，但她对此守口如瓶。

English: Do you know where I can find her?
Chinese: 你知道去哪找她吗？

English: Well, I ((did)) ask her where she was staying - I must admit, I'm just quite nosy like that - and she confessed that the luxuries of the town were not to her liking, though she wouldn't say more on the matter.
Chinese: 嗯，我((确实))问过她住在哪——不得不承认，我就是这么爱管闲事——她说镇上的奢华不合她心意，再多的就不肯讲了。

English: But after she left, I could see her out of my window, making her way back. She strode into the [[forest]], to the [[west]] of Hallowshire.
Chinese: 不过她离开后，我从窗口望见她往回走。她大步走进了哈洛郡[[西边]]的[[森林]]。

English: Of course, with her interest in all things Emberian, I'd wager she'd have taken an interest in that small ruin in the forest. The one with the [[old rusty turbine]], that you can see rising from the trees...
Chinese: 当然啦，以她对余烬事物的痴迷，我敢打赌森林里那座小遗迹她会感兴趣。就是树梢间露出的那台[[生锈的老涡轮]]……

English: Oh, but I really shouldn't be telling you all this, should I? Customer confidentiality, and all that. Maybe keep it between us, hmm?
Chinese: 哦，不过这些话我本不该说的，对吧？什么客户保密之类的。就你知我知，嗯？

English: Thanks for the information.
Chinese: 多谢指点。

English: That's quite alright. Now, was there anything else?
Chinese: 不客气。还有别的事吗？

English: I'm looking for an Emberian key.
Chinese: 我在找一把余烬钥匙。

English: Looking for Emberian antiques, are we? Well, you've certainly come to the right place.##I have a small collection of bits and pieces, from the relatively modest... <<he holds up a rusty piece of junk,>> to the downright ((exquisite.)) <<He holds up another piece of junk.>>
Chinese: 找余烬古董，是吧？那你可算来对地方了。##我这儿收着一些零零碎碎，从相对朴素……<<他举起一件生锈的破烂>>……到极其((精美))的都有。<<他又举起另一件破烂。>>

English: What's with all the rusty junk?
Chinese: 这一堆生锈的破烂是怎么回事？

English: <<He stammers, affronted.>> Why... I'll have you know that these are ((priceless artefacts)), created by legendary Emberian blacksmith-factories before the World Rend. We will never see the likes of such craftsmanship again!
Chinese: <<他结结巴巴，一脸被冒犯。>>你……你可要知道，这些是((无价之宝))，出自世界撕裂前传奇的余烬锻匠工厂。这般工艺，我们再也见不到了！

English: Yes, but what actually ((are they?))
Chinese: 是是是，可它们((到底是什么？))

English: Well, this one is... some type of... component? And this here, well this was clearly an elaborate type of metal... rod! As I said - ((priceless!))
Chinese: 呃，这个是……某种……零件？而这个呢，显然是一根做工精巧的金属……杆！我说过了——((无价之宝！))

English: Oh, I see now. Yes, exquisite indeed.
Chinese: 哦，我懂了。是，确实精美。

English: I'm glad you recognize quality when you see it!
Chinese: 很高兴你识货！

English: I need a key, to open a nearby ruin.
Chinese: 我需要一把钥匙，开附近的一处遗迹。

English: Ah, yes - I often get requests for keys.##There are plenty of old Emberian ruins that - despite being hundreds of years old - have proved impervious to spelunkers and scavengers. So, would-be treasure seekers pin their hopes on a key...
Chinese: 啊，有——常有人来求钥匙。##不少古老的余烬遗迹——虽历经数百年——探险者和拾荒者都奈何不得。于是跃跃欲试的寻宝人就把希望寄托在一把钥匙上……

English: ...but there are innumerable old keys, and innumerable old doors. As I tell most budding tomb raiders, actually opening one would be a matter of astounding luck! ##Although...
Chinese: ……可是古钥匙数不胜数，古门也数不胜数。就像我对每个初出茅庐的盗墓人说的：真能对上一把，那得是逆天的运气！##不过……

English: There was a woman that came by, not long ago, who seemed to know ((exactly)) what she was looking for.
Chinese: 不久前有位女士来过，她似乎((清楚))自己要找什么。

English: This woman - who was she?
Chinese: 那位女士——是谁？

English: About town, she seems to be known as the [[Emberian]]. People seem to think that she's a relic of that time ((herself)) - which, of course, is pure tattle.
Chinese: 镇上都叫她[[余烬人]]。人们似乎觉得她本人就是那个时代的((活化石))——当然，纯属瞎扯。

English: She does seem to be an avid collector, though.##The suit of armour she wears? I've never seen such a well-preserved relic. It outshines anything in my humble collection, that's for certain.
Chinese: 不过她确实像位狂热的收藏家。##她那身铠甲？保存如此完好的遗物我从未见过。肯定比我这寒酸收藏里的任何东西都耀眼。

English: What did she buy?
Chinese: 她买了什么？

English: She bought a key. She described its kind in very specific detail.
Chinese: 她买了一把钥匙。她把钥匙的样子描述得非常具体。

English: Do you know what that key unlocks?
Chinese: 你知道那把钥匙开什么吗？

English: Hah! If I did, I would have closed shop and gone off to use it, long ago!
Chinese: 哈！我要是知道，早关店拿它发财去了！

English: Though, in all honesty, I have often wished to test my collection of keys on that [[Emberian structure]] to the [[east]] of Hallowshire; if only the surrounding [[town]] wasn't teeming with bandits.
Chinese: 不过说实话，我一直想拿我收藏的钥匙去试试哈洛郡[[东边]]那座[[余烬建筑]]；只可惜周围的[[镇子]]满是土匪。

English: Can you tell me about this Emberian ruin?
Chinese: 能给我讲讲那处余烬遗迹吗？

English: Well, it's been sitting there since before the World Rend, of course. As far as I'm aware, the town of [[Rustburg]] grew up around it, as people tried to prise it open and plunder its treasures...
Chinese: 嗯，它当然早在世界撕裂前就立在那儿了。据我所知，[[锈堡]]镇就是在它周围兴起的，人们都想撬开它、掠夺里面的宝藏……

English: ...but they never succeeded. Emberian metal is inscribed with cipher, after all - to make it nearly impenetrable.
Chinese: ……但他们从未得手。余烬金属上錾刻着密文——几乎坚不可摧。

English: Eventually the town was destroyed in the God War, for harbouring Wikkans. It's been home to all sorts of scoundrels and ruffians ever since, but I sincerely doubt they've had better luck with the Emberian ruins.
Chinese: 后来神之战中，那镇子因为窝藏维坎教团被夷平了。此后各种无赖恶棍都拿它当过老巢，但我严重怀疑他们撬余烬遗迹的手气能好到哪去。

English: Do you have another key? I want to buy one.
Chinese: 你还有别的钥匙吗？我想买一把。

English: <<He rummages around in a box of assorted metal parts.>> Ah-ha! You are in luck, my friend. This [[Emberian Key]] seems remarkably similar to the one I sold not long ago.
Chinese: <<他在一盒杂七杂八的金属件里翻找。>>啊哈！你运气真好，我的朋友。这把[[余烬钥匙]]和我不久前卖掉的那把像得出奇。

English: About that Emberian key...
Chinese: 关于那把余烬钥匙……

English: Ah, yes - this [[Emberian Key]] seems remarkably similar to the one I sold not long ago, to that woman in Emberian armour.
Chinese: 啊，对——这把[[余烬钥匙]]和我不久前卖给那个穿余烬铠甲的女人的那把，像得出奇。

English: Of course, what with this one being so ((high in demand)), I couldn't let it go for less than [[twenty coins.]]
Chinese: 当然啦，这把钥匙如今((行情紧俏))，低于[[二十枚硬币]]我可不卖。

English: Okay, here's the coin.
Chinese: 好，钱给你。

English: Splendid, splendid! Here you are; in remarkable condition, I'm sure you'll agree.
Chinese: 好极了，好极了！拿好了；品相出众，你不会不同意吧。

English: Personally, I always wanted to test it in those [[Emberian ruins]] in [[Rustburg,]] to the east.##I have a hunch my ((previous)) customer had the same idea...
Chinese: 就我个人而言，我一直想拿它去东边[[锈堡]]的[[余烬遗迹]]试试。##我有预感，我那位((上一位))顾客也是这么想的……

English: @@ Twenty? You said yourself, it probably won't work...
Chinese: @@ 二十枚？你自己都说了，它多半开不了……

English: %% Hmph, I suppose you're right. Tell you what; just this once, you can have it free of charge. ##But if, by some ((miracle)) you do find some treasure with it, let me take it off your hands... for a ((fair price)), of course.
Chinese: %% 哼，你说得也在理。这样吧；就这一回，白送你。##不过，若你真凭它((奇迹般))找到了宝藏，记得让我接手……当然，得给个((公道价))。

English: Personally, I always wanted to test it in those [[Emberian ruins]] up past [[Rustburg.]] I have a hunch my ((previous)) customer had the same idea...
Chinese: 就我个人而言，我一直想拿它去[[锈堡]]上头那片[[余烬遗迹]]试试。我有预感，我那位((上一位))顾客也是这么想的……

English: && Nonetheless, though possibly useless, these keys are irreplaceable relics. Twenty coins, it is.
Chinese: && 话虽如此，就算可能没用，这种钥匙也是不可替代的文物。就二十枚，不还价。

English: I'll think about it.
Chinese: 我再想想。

English: By all means. Now, was there anything else?
Chinese: 请便。还有别的事吗？

English: Thanks for the information.
Chinese: 多谢指点。

English: That's quite alright.
Chinese: 不客气。

English: Ah... terribly sorry, but it seems you don't have enough, there.
Chinese: 啊……非常抱歉，你的钱好像不够。

English: Now, was there anything else?
Chinese: 还有别的事吗？

English: Have you heard of the Emberian?
Chinese: 听说过余烬人吗？

English: Oh, I saw her once, striding through town like she owned the place. Now, I'm not saying all the stories are true, but there's certainly summin' ((strange)) about that woman...
Chinese: 哦，我见过她一回，大步流星穿过镇子，像这地方是她家开的。我不是说那些传闻都属实，但那女人身上肯定有点((邪门))……

English: She's never come in here, but I've heard she bought summin' from the [[Emporium of Oddities]], up by the end of the street. The one with the crystal spire.
Chinese: 她从没进过我这个门，但听说她在街尾的[[奇物商场]]买过东西。就是有座水晶尖塔的那家。

English: Ah, that Dark Star mercenary? I've not spoken with her myself, but I saw her stride past the shopfront, once.
Chinese: 啊，那个黑星佣兵？我没跟她本人说过话，但见过她从店门前大步走过，就一回。

English: I swear, everyone in the street froze in their place - even the guards. Something about her ((stride)), and that ((armour.)) I'd not like to bump into her after dark, let me tell you!
Chinese: 我发誓，整条街的人都僵在原地——连卫兵都是。她那((步态))，还有那身((铠甲))，就是有股慑人的气势。天黑后撞见她可就不是好玩的事了，我跟你说！

English: <<She releases an exaggerated sigh.>> Unfortunately, I ((have)) heard of this nonsense. Some four-hundred-year-old warrior, yes? Who survived the World Rend and has been wandering about ever since, hitting things with her sword?
Chinese: <<她夸张地叹了口气。>>不巧，这种无稽之谈我((确实))听过。某个四百岁的老战士，对吧？世界撕裂中活了下来，从此四处游荡，逢人就一剑？

English: Please don't bother me with such idle chatter; I really don't have the time.
Chinese: 请别拿这种闲话烦我；我真没那个工夫。

English: ((Heard)) of her? She's come into this 'ere shop, more than once!
Chinese: ((听说))她？她可不止一次进过我这家店！

English: Scared me witless, I'll say. That stare - and that ((armour)). There's something about it. I've been servicing equipment since I was a tyke, but I've never seen ((anything)) of that craftsmanship.
Chinese: 吓得我魂都没了，真的。那眼神——还有那身((铠甲))。就是有股说不出的名堂。我从毛头小子起就干装备修理，那种工艺我从没((见过))。

English: She asked to use the workbench, last time. I saw her take off one of those pauldrons and tinker with it. It was full of the most intricate machinery - and she knew ((exactly)) what she was doing.
Chinese: 上回她借用了工作台。我看见她卸下一块肩甲摆弄。里面满满都是最精密的机括——而她((门儿清))自己在干什么。

English: If you ask me, the stories are true, and she really ((is)) four hundred years old. After all, those Endless live forever, right? Who's to say the Emberians didn't figure it out, too?
Chinese: 要我说，传闻是真的，她((真))有四百岁。毕竟那些无尽者不就永生嘛，对吧？谁能断定余烬人没琢磨出同样的门道？

English: Now look 'ere. This is ((my)) tree, and that's ((my)) loot. So get lost, y'hear?
Chinese: 喂，看着点。这是((我))的树，那是((我))的战利品。滚吧，听见没？

English: You again?
Chinese: 又是你？

English: Uh, do you live here?
Chinese: 呃，你住这儿？

English: Aye, I've been 'ere for ((sixty years,)) since before the damned ((apostates)) blasted the place to smithereens.
Chinese: 啊，我在这儿住了((六十年，))早在那帮该死的((叛教者))把镇子轰成渣之前就住下了。

English: What is this town?
Chinese: 这镇子是什么来历？

English: Time was, this town was called [[Rustburg]], on account of all the merchants selling Emberian junk.
Chinese: 想当年，这镇子叫[[锈堡]]，因为满街商人都在卖余烬破烂。

English: Y'see, there's an old [[Emberian ruin]] up there; an' plenty of detritus. Though, in all the time the town's been 'ere, they never ((did)) crack open the big ol' doors. Some o' that magic metal still holds tight, no matter how many cannons you blast at it.
Chinese: 你瞧，上头有座古[[余烬遗迹]]；碎铜烂铁遍地都是。可镇子存在这么久，那些大老爷门愣是((没人))撬开过。那种魔法金属结实得很，轰多少炮都不带松口的。

English: Why is this place such a wreck?
Chinese: 这地方怎么破败成这样？

English: Well, 'bout forty years ago was the God War. The apostates - ((I guess we call 'em the)) Union ((now)) - they caught wind of some Wikkan holdouts, an' blasted the whole town with a fortress ship.
Chinese: 唉，约四十年前是神之战。那些叛教者——((我想如今都管他们叫))联盟((了))——听说有维坎残党藏着，就用一艘要塞舰把整座镇子轰平了。

English: Hallow Town was fine, so most folk just moved there. Nobody ever rebuilt Rustburg.
Chinese: 哈洛镇完好无损，大多数人就搬过去了。锈堡从此没人重建。

English: Thanks for the story.
Chinese: 多谢你讲这些。

English: S'alright.
Chinese: 没事。

English: Do you know a way into the town?
Chinese: 你知道进镇的路子吗？

English: Y'need to get into that big stone tower, there. But there's two ways round, see. You can go the long way - with all the goblins an' moths, or you can go the ((special)) way.
Chinese: 你得进那座大石塔。不过路有两条，瞧好了。你可以走远路——满路的哥布林和飞蛾——也可以走((特别的))路。

English: @@Can you tell me the ((special)) way in?
Chinese: @@ ((特别的))路是什么，能说说吗？

English: %%Well, I guess you seem like an alright sort.
Chinese: %% 嗯，看你小子还算顺眼。

English: When there were Wikkans living 'ere, they hid the nearby [[bridge]] with magic. It's right there, but you can use a [[Truth Potion]] to see it. Lets you sneak past all those gobbos real good.
Chinese: 当年维坎教团住在这儿时，用魔法把附近的[[桥]]藏了起来。桥就在那儿，用一瓶[[真言药水]]就能看见。能让你神不知鬼不觉绕过那帮哥布林。

English: &&Well, if I went telling every damn fool about it, it wouldn't be ((special)) no more, would it? So you can sod off.
Chinese: && 要是我见个蠢货就告诉一遍，那还叫什么((特别的))路，你说是不是？滚吧你。

English: Okay, thanks.
Chinese: 好，多谢。

English: <<He grunts.>>
Chinese: <<他哼了一声。>>

English: I'll leave you be.
Chinese: 不打扰你了。

English: I thought I told you to get lost?
Chinese: 我不是让你滚了吗？

English: <<The woman stands in full armour as she tinkers with an assortment of junk. Her head snaps around as you approach.>>
Chinese: <<那女人全副武装，正摆弄一堆破烂。你走近时，她的头猛地转了过来。>>

English: Looks like you're ((lost)), wanderer. If you value your neck, I'd be lost someplace ((else.))
Chinese: 看来你((迷路))了，流浪汉。要是还想保住脑袋，就换个地方((迷。))

English: Wait - you're the Emberian, right?
Chinese: 等等——你就是余烬人，对吧？

English: I'm looking for a Dark Star mercenary.
Chinese: 我在找一个黑星佣兵。

English: I'll make myself scarce, then.
Chinese: 那我这就消失。

English: <<She turns to you, grimacing, and shoulders her greatsword with a clang.>> ##Hmph. Another bounty hunter?
Chinese: <<她转过身来，龇着牙，铿的一声把巨剑扛上肩。>>##哼。又一个赏金猎人？

English: As I told the last of you sods, I don't sail with the Dark Stars no more - but I can cleave you in two all the same.
Chinese: 跟你们这帮家伙上回那位说的一样，我早不给黑星卖命了——但把你劈成两半的本事还在。

English: Basalt sent me. We're on the same side.
Chinese: 巴索特派我来的。我们是一条道上的人。

English: Basalt? So that old bastard put you on my trail, eh? The old sod never ((could)) keep his mouth shut.
Chinese: 巴索特？合着那个老混蛋让你来追我，嗯？那老东西的嘴就((没))严实过。

English: Woah - I want your help, not your head.
Chinese: 哇——我要的是你帮忙，不是你的脑袋。

English: It's Vela I'm after.
Chinese: 我要找的是薇拉。

English: <<You feel her gaze as she grips her sword.>>
Chinese: <<她握剑的手一紧，你能感到她的目光。>>

English: Oh yeah? And why, exactly, would you need little ol' ((me?))
Chinese: 哦是吗？你到底为什么需要((小小的我))呢？

English: I'm looking for Vela. We've got to stop her.
Chinese: 我在找薇拉。我们得拦住她。

English: <<Hearing Vela's name, she flinches.>> ##((Vela?)) I'm ((done)) with that devil, you hear?
Chinese: <<听见薇拉的名字，她缩了一下。>>##((薇拉？))那个恶魔我((受够了))，听见没？

English: If you want to stop her, be my guest. Cut her to pieces - sail a skyship into her corpse! Do it with my blessing, but I'll have no part in it.
Chinese: 你想拦她，请自便。把她剁成碎块——开着飞艇碾过她的尸体！全当我祝福你了，但我绝不掺和。

English: I'm looking for Vela. I want to help her.
Chinese: 我在找薇拉。我想帮她。

English: And if you want to assist with her madcap plan, you're worse than the wretched bounty hunters - but following her into oblivion will kill you surer than I ever could.
Chinese: 你要是想帮着她那个疯计划，那你比那些可怜的赏金猎人还不如——不过跟着她奔向湮灭，死得可比我动手利索多了。

English: If I don't find Vela, I'm dead.
Chinese: 找不到薇拉，我就是死路一条。

English: And if you think I'll track her down just to save your sorry neck, you're ((dead)) wrong.
Chinese: 你要是觉得我会为了救你那可怜的小命去追查她，那你就((错))到家了。

English: But I thought you and Vela were comrades?
Chinese: 可你们和薇拉不是同伴吗？

English: ((Comrades?)) Hah! Vela was more than a comrade. ##<<She slams her blade upright.>> She was a ((sister)) to me. I owe my ((life)) to that girl.
Chinese: ((同伴？))哈！薇拉何止是((同伴))。##<<她把剑拄在地上。>>她是我((姐妹))。那条命都是她给的。

English: Seems to me like you're ((scared)) of her.
Chinese: 我看你是((怕))她吧。

English: Pah! ((Scared!?)) ##<<She leans towards you, sword scraping against armour.>>
Chinese: 呸！((怕！？))##<<她朝你倾身，剑刃刮着铠甲作响。>>

English: Damn right I'm scared. And you should be too.
Chinese: 怕，我怕得一点没错。你也该怕。

English: Do you think she got her reputation with ((stern words))? I've seen her best a tavernful of ruffians with her good arm behind her back. I've seen her slice off the head of a voidbeast without breaking a sweat. I've seen her square up to a ((god)).
Chinese: 你以为她的凶名是靠((说狠话))挣来的？我见过她单手背后、放倒一酒馆的恶棍。我见过她面不改色削掉虚空兽的脑袋。我见过她跟((神))对面刚。

English: But... she was also ((more)) than all that. She was a sister to me. I owe my ((life)) to that girl.
Chinese: 可……她((不止))是这些。她是我((姐妹))。那条命都是她给的。

English: If she's such a devil, why did you idolise her?
Chinese: 她既然这么恶魔，你以前为什么崇拜她？

English: <<She shifts, and looks away.>> ##Time was, I thought she really could make the world better. Little by little, with blood and sweat and grit, I thought we were ((doing)) it...
Chinese: <<她挪了挪身子，望向别处。>>##曾几何时，我真以为她能让世界变好。一点一点，用血汗和骨头，我以为我们((真在))做到……

English: <<She inhales. >> ##But then she found it.
Chinese: <<她吸了口气。>>##直到她找到了那样东西。

English: What happened between you?
Chinese: 你们之间发生了什么？

English: <<She sighs.>> She found something. Before then, I thought... maybe we really ((could)) make the world a better place. But then... we found it, untouched for hundreds of years...
Chinese: <<她叹了口气。>>她找到了一样东西。在那之前，我以为……也许我们((真能))让世界变好。可后来……我们找到了它，沉睡了几百年无人惊扰……

English: A map. Buried in some Emberian tomb, that pointed to something impossible. I told her to ((leave)) it. To not put her faith in ancient, cursed things. ##She ((promised me)).
Chinese: 一张地图。埋在某座余烬古墓里，指向一样不可能存在的东西。我让她((收手))。别把信念押在古老受诅咒的东西上。##她((答应过我))。

English: But she led us to our doom, anyway. Vela plunged the Dark Stars beneath the clouds with our best ships - our flagship and galleon both - In pursuit of an Emberian artefact that was more likely to ((end)) the world than save it.
Chinese: 可她照样把我们带向了灭亡。薇拉带着黑星一头扎进云海之下，用的是我们最好的两条船——旗舰和盖伦帆船——就为追一件与其说((拯救))世界、不如说会终结世界的余烬造物。

English: On that day she was not my sister.
Chinese: 那一天，她不是我姐妹。

English: As captain of the ((Black Goblin)), I told my crew to fire upon their comrades. We splintered the hull of Vela's ship with our cannons, before we boarded and clashed swords.##It was mutiny. ((Fratricide))...
Chinese: 作为((黑妖精号))的船长，我下令向昔日的战友开火。我们的炮撕碎了薇拉的船壳，然后接舷厮杀。##那是哗变。是((手足相残))……

English: <<Her fists are clenched tight, trembling.>> But while I stalled her plans that day, I couldn't stop her. ##<<She twists her mouth into a grim smile.>> I never could.
Chinese: <<她的拳头攥得死紧，微微发颤。>>那天我拖住了她的计划，却终究没能拦住她。##<<她嘴角扭曲成苦笑。>>从来都拦不住。

English: What is Vela trying to find?
Chinese: 薇拉到底在找什么？

English: Something called the [[Cradle]], buried deep in the underlands. What it actually ((is)), we don't know - but If Vela's right, it could be used to alter the very ((language)) of the cosmos. That means she could end poverty, suffering, even ((death)) itself...
Chinese: 一样叫[[摇篮]]的东西，深埋在地下之地。它((究竟))是什么，没人知道——但如果薇拉没说错，它能改写宇宙的((语言))本身。也就是说，她可以终结贫困、苦难，甚至((死亡))本身……

English: ...but she's more likely to end the ((world.)) The Emberians were known to meddle with forces they couldn't control. She is a damn fool for chasing their accursed dreams.
Chinese: ……但她更可能终结的是((世界。))余烬人玩弄自己驾驭不了的力量，那可是出了名的。追着他们那些该死的梦跑，她是个天大的傻子。

English: You have to finish what you started.
Chinese: 你必须做完你起头的事。

English: <<She laughs.>> I could not defeat her with a galleon of hardened mercenaries. What makes you think I would try again now? With naught but ((you?))
Chinese: <<她大笑。>>当年一整艘盖伦船的老兵我都没能打赢她。你觉得我现在凭什么再试？就凭((你))？

English: If you care for her, you have to find her.
Chinese: 你要是在乎她，就得找到她。

English: ((Do)) I? And what would you know of the matter? I sailed with Vela for years, while I've known you mere moments; what could you possibly know of our camaraderie?
Chinese: ((我))在乎？这事你又懂什么？我和薇拉同船多年，认识你才几分钟；我们的交情，你哪只眼睛看得懂？

English: You're just running away.
Chinese: 你只是在逃避。

English: <<She is silent a moment.>> Is there shame in running, when you have naught else to do but lick your wounds?
Chinese: <<她沉默片刻。>>除了舔舐伤口别无他事可做时，逃开又有什么可耻？

English: No, that chapter of my life is over. I will not chase that woman's dream any more, not to help nor hinder. I have a pilgrimage of my own to tread; my ((own)) answers to find.
Chinese: 不，我人生的那一章已经翻篇。我不会再去追那个女人的梦，既不相帮，也不阻拦。我有自己的朝圣路要走；有((自己))的答案要找。

English: If you've come to seek help in finding Vela, my answer is still no. I have a pilgrimage of my own to tread; my ((own)) answers to find.
Chinese: 你要是为找薇拉的事来求助，我的答案还是不行。我有自己的朝圣路要走；有((自己))的答案要找。

English: Maybe I can help you.
Chinese: 也许我能帮你。

English: Hah! And what makes you think I'd need your help? I can handle myself just fine.
Chinese: 哈！你哪来的自信觉得我需要你帮？我自己应付得来。

English: Will you at least answer my questions?
Chinese: 那你至少肯回答我的问题吧？

English: I'll hear them. I can't promise to give them an answer.
Chinese: 说说看。我可不保证答。

English: What are you looking for?
Chinese: 你在找什么？

English: <<She chuckles to herself.>> For a long time, I've had the strangest dreams. Of impossible cities that no mason could build, which twinkle with a thousand tiny stars...
Chinese: <<她自顾自轻笑。>>很长时间以来，我总做些最古怪的梦。梦见不可能存在的城市，任何石匠都造不出来，闪烁着千万颗细小的星……

English: I want to know if my dreams are ((real.))
Chinese: 我想知道我的梦是不是((真的。))

English: I don't understand.
Chinese: 我不明白。

English: <<She smirks.>> You wouldn't.
Chinese: <<她坏笑。>>你当然不明白。

English: And where would you find your answer?
Chinese: 那你打算去哪找答案？

English: There's another Emberian ruin here, in the Oneiric Isles - even bigger than this one. But without the right key, it's sealed shut.
Chinese: 梦幻群岛这儿还有另一处余烬遗迹——比这处还大。但没有对的钥匙，它封得死死的。

English: @@And... where would you get such a key?
Chinese: @@ 那……你从哪弄到的钥匙？

English: %%This type of key is rare - I paid a good sum of money for mine at that shop with the [[crystal spire,]] in Hallow Town.
Chinese: %% 这种钥匙很稀有——我那把是花大价钱在哈洛镇那家有[[水晶尖塔]]的店里买的。

English: But if you're thinkin' of following in my tracks, I'd think twice. That old Emberian ruin up by [[Rustford]] is likely full of perils. You'd only get yourself killed.
Chinese: 不过你要是想踩着我的脚印跟来，我劝你三思。[[锈堡]]上头那座老余烬遗迹多半步步凶险。你只会把自己送命。

English: &&I'm not falling for that. If you plan on following in my tracks, you'll only get yourself killed.
Chinese: && 我才不上这个当。你要是打算踩着我的脚印跟来，只会把自己送命。

English: Never mind, I had other questions...
Chinese: 算了，我还有别的问题……

English: <<She grunts.>> So be it.
Chinese: <<她哼了一声。>>随便。

English: Is it true you're a real Emberian?
Chinese: 你是真余烬人吗，是真的吗？

English: <<She flashes a cynical smile.>> ##If you're asking if I'm a four hundred year old immortal who's been lugging my sword around the skyrealms, I'll have to disappoint you.
Chinese: <<她露出讥诮的笑。>>##你要是问我，是不是个扛着剑在天空领域晃了四百年的不死老怪物，那可要让你失望了。

English: But there is some truth to those rumours. I know my way around those old Emberian ruins; some even feel like ((home.))
Chinese: 但那些传闻也有几分是真的。我熟悉那些古余烬遗迹的门道；有些地方甚至让我觉得像((家))。

English: And yes, this ((is)) authentic Emberian armour, pneumatics intact. This suit stopped a direct cannonball in the siege of Molavia... even if I ((did)) shit blood for a week.
Chinese: 没错，这((确实))是正宗的余烬铠甲，气动系统完好无损。莫拉维亚围城战里，这套甲硬抗过一发直射的炮弹……代价是我((拉了))一星期的血。

English: I've met with Basalt. He's helping me find Vela.
Chinese: 我见过巴索特了。他在帮我找薇拉。

English: The old sea dog's still going, eh? I half thought he'd drowned himself with mushroom grog.
Chinese: 那老海盗还活着呢，嗯？我还以为他早醉死在蘑菇酒里了。

English: To tell the truth, I always respected the man. He was with us from the beginning, and I don't think the Dark Stars would have got far without him.
Chinese: 说实话，我一直敬重那个人。他从一开始就和我们同船，要没有他，黑星走不了多远。

English: Okay, that's all.
Chinese: 好，就这些。

English: <<She nods.>>
Okay, I'll leave you be... for now.
Chinese: 好吧，先不打扰你了……暂时。

English: <<She smirks.>> Something makes me think you won't give up easily - but I won't be staying here long.
Chinese: <<她坏笑。>>不知怎么，我觉得你不会轻易放弃——不过我也不会在这儿久留。

English: And for your own sake, don't bother following me. The place I'm headed isn't for the faint of heart, and if you try and track me down, I'd only have another foolish death on my conscience.
Chinese: 听劝，别费劲跟着我。我要去的地方可不是胆小鬼待的，你若执意追踪，我良心上又得多背一条蠢死的命。

English: Besides, without one of ((these...)) <<She holds up an ancient Emberian key>> ...you won't be getting very far.
Chinese: 再说，没有一把((这个……))<<她举起一把古老的余烬钥匙>>……你走不了多远。

English: So, sod off and leave me in peace.
Chinese: 所以，滚吧，让我清净清净。

English: <<The Emberian breathes heavily, leaning on her sword.>>
Chinese: <<余烬人拄着剑，粗重地喘息。>>

English: I could tell you were a persistent one. Though I have to admit, I didn't think you'd make it in here.
Chinese: 我早看出来你是个死缠烂打的主。不过得承认，我没想到你能打进这里。

English: Still, you're lucky I got here first. These synthetics would have torn you limb from limb. <<She grins.>>
Chinese: 不过你运气好，我抢先一步。这些合成人本来会把你撕成碎块的。<<她咧嘴一笑。>>

English: I came to help you.
Chinese: 我是来帮你的。

English: <<She chuckles.>> I don't need your help, and I know you're only after mine. So, the answer's still ((no.))
Chinese: <<她轻笑。>>我不需要你帮，我也知道你图的只是我的帮忙。所以，答案还是((不行。))

English: I won't give up until you help me.
Chinese: 你不答应我就不走。

English: Hah! Then your persistence will be the death of you.
Chinese: 哈！那你这份执着迟早害死你。

English: What a surprise! This is ((pure)) coincidence.
Chinese: 真巧啊！这是((纯粹))的巧合。

English: Oh, I'm ((sure.)) This place has been sealed up for hundreds of years, and suddenly two keyholders open it up at the ((same time?))
Chinese: 哦，你((肯定是。))这地方封了几百年，突然两个持钥人((同时))把它打开了？

English: Now, stay out of my way. Behind that door are the answers I seek - I've just got to catch my breath...
Chinese: 现在，别挡我的路。那扇门后面有我追寻的答案——我只是得先喘口气……

English: <<The Emberian kneels, head bowed, sagging beneath the weight of her armour. Her body convulses. After a moment, you realise she's quietly sobbing.>>
Chinese: <<余烬人跪着，低着头，整个人在铠甲的重压下垮塌。她的身体在抽动。片刻后你才意识到，她在无声地啜泣。>>

English: <<Hearing you approach, she falls silent.>>
Chinese: <<听见你走近，她安静了下来。>>

English: What is this place?
Chinese: 这地方是什么？

English: <<She looks around her, as the glass coffins and the bodies within.>> ##A good question. I've... searched for the answer... all my life.
Chinese: <<她环顾四周，看着那些玻璃棺，和棺中的躯体。>>##好问题。我……用一生……寻找这个答案。

English: Is that... a corpse?
Chinese: 那是……一具尸体？

English: <<She sighs.>> It is. Whether they were once ((alive)), breathing the same air as us, I cannot say.
Chinese: <<她叹了口气。>>是的。他们是否曾经((活过))、是否呼吸过和我们一样的空气，我说不清。

English: Uh, are you okay?
Chinese: 呃，你还好吗？

English: <<You catch a faint smile.>> Not really.
Chinese: <<你瞥见一丝淡淡的笑。>>不太好。

English: You know... she ((found)) me in one of these places. In one of those... coffins.
Chinese: 你知道吗……她就是在这样一个地方((找到))我的。在其中一个……棺材里。

English: It was Vela. She was eight years old.##When she pulled me out of that machine, coughing up ancient fluids, I couldn't have been much older.
Chinese: 是薇拉。那年她八岁。##她把我从那台机器里拖出来，我咳着古老的液体——那时我也大不了多少。

English: Nothing to explain who I was. How I got there. Just an inscription on the vat which read 'Orlaith'; so that's what they called me.
Chinese: 没有任何东西说明我是谁、怎么到的这里。只有缸体上一块铭牌，写着"奥莱丝"；他们便这么叫我。

English: And so I was born into this world. I was lucky - Vela's father took me in, and schooled me like his daughter. But I never found anyone who could explain my strange birth. I never found anyone... like ((me.))
Chinese: 就这样，我降生于这个世界。我算幸运——薇拉的父亲收留了我，像教导女儿一样教导我。但我从未找到一个能解释我奇异出身的人。也从未找到一个……((和我一样))的人。

English: I thought this place might be different from the others - I thought it might ((explain)) something. But it's just another dead end.
Chinese: 我以为这里会和别处不同——我以为它也许能((解释))点什么。结果又是条死路。

English: You were born from one of... ((those)) things?
Chinese: 你是从……((那种))东西里生出来的？

English: So you really ((are)) an Emberian.
Chinese: 这么说你((真的))是余烬人。

English: Who can say? ##Perhaps, before the World Rend, I was raised by a loving family who thought I'd be safe here. Or maybe I'm just a child of machines and magic?
Chinese: 谁说得清呢？##也许在世界撕裂之前，某个疼爱我的家庭以为把我放在这里会安全。又或许，我只是机器与魔法的造物？

English: You didn't remember anything... from ((before))?
Chinese: 你完全不记得……((以前))的事？

English: I have ((dreams)) of long-lost places, but no recollection of a... family. Maybe I had one, once? Or maybe I was... ((made)), not born.
Chinese: 我会((梦见))失落的久远之地，却对……家人毫无记忆。也许我曾经有过？又或许我是被((制造))出来的，而不是生出来的。

English: I'll never know for sure; I understand that now. But though none of these rusted tombs have given me answers, each one has fuelled my ((anger)).
Chinese: 我永远不会确切知道了；如今我明白这一点。虽然这些锈蚀的坟墓从没给过我答案，但每一座都在给我的((怒火))添柴。

English: The Emberians threaded their needle through the world, altering its tapestry to their whims. And for what? The more I learn, the more I see their greed, their self interest - their lust for ((power)).
Chinese: 余烬人把他们的针脚缝满世界，随心所欲地改织它的锦缎。图什么？我知道得越多，就越看清他们的贪婪、他们的私利——他们对((权柄))的欲望。

English: And in the end, it destroyed them. It destroyed ((our world.)) Scholars can debate over scant evidence for an age, but who doesn't feel the truth in their guts? Four hundred years ago, the Emberians caused the [[World Rend]] with their feckless ambition.
Chinese: 而到头来，这毁灭了他们。毁灭了((我们的世界。))学者们能为贫瘠的证据争论一个时代，可谁的内脏感受不到真相？四百年前，是余烬人用他们不负责任的野心酿成了[[世界撕裂]]。

English: ((That)) is their legacy, and I feel the weight of their sins.
Chinese: ((那))就是他们的遗产，而我感受着他们罪孽的重量。

English: But how could ((you)) change that?
Chinese: 可((你))又能怎么改变它呢？

English: What can anyone do about ages past, but try to banish their lingering phantoms?
Chinese: 对逝去的时代，除了驱散它徘徊不去的幽灵，谁还能做什么？

English: For the Emberian age haunts us still. The Apostatic Union, the Inquisition, the Clockwork Kingdom... they all seek to harness that ancient evil. ##We can't repeat those mistakes. I thought Vela ((understood)) that...
Chinese: 余烬时代至今仍纠缠着我们。叛教联盟、宗教裁判所、发条王国……它们都想驾驭那份古老的邪恶。##我们不能重蹈覆辙。我以为薇拉((明白))这一点……

English: So, Vela betrayed your beliefs.
Chinese: 所以，薇拉背叛了你的信念。

English: So, you turned on your own crewmates.
Chinese: 所以，你对自家船员倒戈相向。

English: The Emberians are long gone; their guilt is not yours to bear.
Chinese: 余烬人早已消亡；他们的罪不必由你来背。

English: You are right. It should not be ((my)) guilt alone; it should burden us ((all)). For we can see, plainly as by starlight, the injustice that was wrought upon the world. When such putrid histories repeat, do we not have a ((duty)) to act?
Chinese: 你说得对。那不该是((我))一个人的罪责；它该压在((我们所有人))身上。因为那桩加诸世界的不义，我们看得清清楚楚，如同星光下的白昼。当如此腐臭的历史重演时，我们难道没有((责任))行动吗？

English: All of this I said to Vela, time and time again.
Chinese: 这些话我对薇拉说了一遍又一遍。

English: So ((this)) is why you turned on Vela.
Chinese: 所以((这就是))你倒戈薇拉的原因。

English: You're right.
Chinese: 你说得对。

English: <<She sighs.>> At first, I thought Vela would simply ((listen)) to me. We had often plundered harmless Emberian relics, while leaving that which seemed unstable or dangerous. Why should this be any different?
Chinese: <<她叹了口气。>>起初，我以为薇拉会((听))我一句。我们没少打捞无害的余烬遗物，而对那些看起来不稳定、危险的，我们向来绕道。这次会有什么不同？

English: But the map we found, and the artefact it promised - they rekindled something in her. A passion, an ((ambition)) that could not be quelled. She was determined to change the world, even if it meant ((dooming)) it.
Chinese: 可我们找到的那张地图，和它许诺的造物——重新点燃了她心中的什么。一种无法平息的狂热，一种((野心))。她执意要改变世界，哪怕这意味着((葬送))世界。

English: <<She unfurls her hands, staring at them.>> So what options did I have left, other than my sword? I spilled the blood of my friends. My ((family.))
Chinese: <<她摊开双手，怔怔盯着。>>那么除了拔剑，我还剩什么选择？我洒了朋友的血。我((家人))的血。

English: And still, I failed.
Chinese: 即便如此，我失败了。

English: You've not failed, not yet. Together we'll finish what you started.
Chinese: 你还没失败，还没有。我们一起把你没做完的事做完。

English: <<She sighs. For a moment she is still.>>
Chinese: <<她叹了口气。有一瞬，她静止不动。>>

English: <<But then she looks at you, a fire in her eyes. >> You're right.
Chinese: <<但随即她看向你，眼中燃着火。>>你说得对。

English: For too long I've clung to the past. Felt like I ((owed)) Vela something. But this is bigger than the two of us. Bigger than ((anything)) else...
Chinese: 太久以来我一直抓着过去不放。总觉得我((欠))薇拉什么。可这件事比我们两个都大。比((一切))都大……

English: If I have to kill my sister to save the world, so be it.
Chinese: 如果必须杀死我的姐妹才能拯救世界，那就来吧。

English: Just promise me one thing: ##If, against the odds, we manage to fight our way to Vela - leave her to ((me)), okay?
Chinese: 只求你答应我一件事：##倘若我们真有奇迹，一路杀到薇拉面前——把她((留给))我，好吗？

English: Perhaps we can stop Vela without more bloodshed.
Chinese: 也许我们不用再流血就能拦住薇拉。

English: So what, you want to sail over to the most notorious cutthroat in the skyrealms and ((ask her nicely?))
Chinese: 那又如何，你想飞到全天空领域最凶名昭著的杀人狂面前，((好声好气地求她？))

English: <<She chuckles.>> I like it.
Chinese: <<她轻笑。>>我喜欢。

English: I've survived more foolish plans - and I'm done sifting through rusty tombs, anyway.
Chinese: 比这蠢的计划我都活下来了——反正我也受够了在生锈的坟墓里翻拣。

English: Maybe... maybe if we really ((can)) stop her, this won't all have been for nothing.
Chinese: 也许……也许如果我们真能((拦住))她，这一切就不算白费。

English: Vela is trying to ((save)) the world. Let's help her, together.
Chinese: 薇拉是想((拯救))世界的。我们一起帮她。

English: <<She looks at you with determination, fists clenched.>> ##No. I ((won't)) help her...
Chinese: <<她双拳紧握，决然看向你。>>##不。我((不会))帮她……

English: <<She inhales.>> ...but I'm done running.
Chinese: <<她吸了口气。>>……但我不逃了。

English: It seems we're in a predicament. I'm the only other person in the skyrealms who saw the map she's following. I ((know)) where she's gone, but I can't get there on my own. Not without the right ship, and a pilot..
Chinese: 看来我们处境相仿。全天空领域见过她那张地图的，除她之外只有我。我((知道))她去了哪，但我一个人到不了。没有合适的船，没有舵手……

English: So perhaps we can help each other, for now. I'll tag along with your little expedition, until we find her. But after that? Well, I guess we'll have to see...
Chinese: 所以眼下我们不妨互相搭把手。你那点小小远征，我捎带同行，直到找到她为止。至于之后？嘿嘿，走着瞧……

English: It's settled, then.
Chinese: 那就这么说定了。

English: <<She nods.>> I'll help you. ##I'm the only other person in the skyrealms who saw the map Vela's following, so I know where to find her. But we'll need others.
Chinese: <<她点头。>>我帮你。##全天空领域见过薇拉那张地图的，除她之外只有我，所以我知道去哪找她。但我们还需要更多人。

English: Oh, and... ## ...thank you.
Chinese: 对了，还有……##……谢谢你。

English: I heard you captured Vela's old fortress, the [[Blinding Light]]. I'll make my way there.
Chinese: 听说你拿下了薇拉的旧要塞，[[炫光要塞]]。我会自行前往。

English: Ah, the [[Blinding Light.]] You know, I thought I'd never see this place again.
Chinese: 啊，[[炫光要塞]]。你知道吗，我原以为这辈子再也见不到这地方了。

English: How are you settling in?
Chinese: 你住得还习惯吗？

English: Makes my skin crawl, seeing Inquisition agents scurrying around. Keep thinking they're gonna grab me an' throw me in a cell...
Chinese: 看着宗教裁判所探员跑来跑去，我浑身起鸡皮疙瘩。总觉得他们随时会一把揪住我，扔进牢房……

English: But if siding with this lot is the only way to get to Vela, I suppose I'll have to get used to it.
Chinese: 但如果投靠这帮人是接近薇拉的唯一办法，我想我也只好慢慢习惯。

English: I wanted to ask you something.
Chinese: 我想请教你些事。

English: I'll oblige.
Chinese: 悉听尊便。

English: About the task at hand...
Chinese: 关于眼下的事……

English: I hear you're gathering a bunch of former Dark Stars, right? Well, I'll help you best I can.
Chinese: 听说你在招拢一批前黑星，对吧？行，我尽力帮你。

English: First of all, you'd better find Vela's old quartermaster; Jack Basalt. If he's in town, he'll surely be in the [[Wobbly Noggin]] pub. He always ((did)) have a weakness for the strong stuff, after all.
Chinese: 首先，你最好找到薇拉的老军需官：杰克·巴索特。他若在镇上，肯定泡在[[摇晃酒馆]]。毕竟他向来((就好))烈酒这口。

English: If you're looking for the Duchess, she'll probably be back at her family manor in the [[Endless Realm.]] Can't say for sure where it is, though.
Chinese: 找女公爵的话，她多半回了[[无尽领域]]的家族庄园。不过具体在哪，我说不准。

English: Now, Caxton Frost - he always struck me as a little odd. Though, I suppose the feeling was probably mutual. Maybe he returned to the [[Clockwork Kingdom?]]
Chinese: 至于卡克斯顿·弗罗斯特——他总让我觉得有点怪。当然，估计我看他也一样。也许他回[[发条王国]]了？

English: About your past...
Chinese: 关于你的过去……

English: <<She says nothing.>>
Chinese: <<她一言不发。>>

English: So you were really found in an Emberian vat?
Chinese: 所以你真是从余烬人培养槽里被找到的？

English: That's what I said, didn't I? ##Vela found me in a vat of liquid in some Emberian ruin, back when we were children.
Chinese: 我是这么说的，不是吗？##我们还是孩子的时候，薇拉在某个余烬遗迹的一缸液体里发现了我。

English: There was no clue who I was, or how long I'd been there; save for a metal plaque that read 'Orlaith'. So, that's what they called me.
Chinese: 没有丝毫线索表明我是谁、在那儿躺了多久；只有一块金属铭牌，写着"奥莱丝"。于是他们就这么叫我。

English: I awoke with a head full of knowledge: how to speak Old Emberian, how to ((fight)), how to use ancient, useless machines... ##But I didn't have any ((memories)) of my own. Just faded dreams of sparkling cities.
Chinese: 我醒来时满脑子都是知识：怎么讲古余烬语，怎么((搏杀))，怎么操作那些古老而无用的机器……##可我没有任何((属于自己的记忆))。只有几段流光城市褪色的梦。

English: Vela's father was furious with her, of course - for sneaking off into ruins by herself. He threw Vela in the brig along with me. <<She smiles.>> Not that Vela cared. She was so excited. Her very own ((Emberian)) friend...
Chinese: 薇拉的父亲当然大发雷霆——因为她自己偷偷溜进遗迹。他把薇拉和我一起关了禁闭。<<她微笑。>>薇拉压根不在乎。她兴奋极了。她有了一个((专属的))余烬人朋友……

English: You said Vela was like a sister to you.
Chinese: 你说过薇拉情同你的姐妹。

English: After she found me, Vela eventually convinced her father to... ((adopt)) me. Of course, he had me stay with the servants - but it was better than being pawned off to the Erudite Academy as some ((curiosity)).
Chinese: 她找到我之后，薇拉最终说服她父亲……((收养))了我。当然，他让我和仆人住在一起——但这总比被当件((稀罕玩意))送给博识学院强。

English: And he gave me an education, just like his daughter. When we weren't studying, we played all over the manor. It was ((huge)) - but back then, I thought ((everyone)) in the skyrealms lived like kings.
Chinese: 他还让我和他女儿受同样的教育。不读书的时候，我们就在庄园里四处疯玩。那庄园((大得))没边——那时我还以为天空领域里((人人))都过着帝王般的日子。

English: Vela's father was an admiral in the Apostatic Union navy, y'see. And when we were ready, he had Vela groomed for command. We served on the same navy ship with Captain Basalt - though ((my)) hammock swung with the deckhands. ##<<She sighs.>> That's when I saw the skyrealms for what they truly were.
Chinese: 要知道，薇拉的父亲是叛教联盟海军的将军。等我们成年，他安排薇拉受训掌兵。我们和巴索特船长同在一条军舰上服役——不过((我的))吊床是和水手们挂在一处的。##<<她叹了口气。>>就是在那时，我看清了天空领域的真面目。

English: And then... there was the ((Dyshaan massacre)). That was the day... that Isabet died.
Chinese: 然后……发生了((迪尚屠杀))。那一天……伊莎贝特死了。

English: Something snapped in Vela, that day. She could no longer trust the Union - or her father. So she resolved to ((leave)). We stowed away, as deserters - but at the last moment Captain Basalt himself caught us.
Chinese: 那一天，薇拉心里有什么东西断了。她再也无法信任联盟——也无法信任她父亲。于是她决意((离开))。我们偷渡出逃，当了逃兵——可在最后一刻，巴索特船长亲自抓到了我们。

English: I thought we were done for - that we'd be thrown in some dungeon to rot. ##But Basalt? I think he was as shaken as us. He took the rudder without a word, and we all left together. I suppose the Dark Stars were born that day.
Chinese: 我以为我们完蛋了——要被扔进哪个地牢里烂掉。##可巴索特呢？我想他和我们一样动摇了。他一言不发地握住船舵，我们一同离开了。我想，黑星就是那天诞生的。

English: Tell me of your time as a Dark Star merc.
Chinese: 讲讲你当黑星佣兵的那段日子吧。

English: Y'know, a few years back - if you'd caught us in a tavern, with bellies full of grog, we'd have sung you songs that would've made you laugh. And cry. And regurgitate your supper.
Chinese: 要知道，几年前——你要是在酒馆里碰上喝得肚圆的我们，我们会给你唱些歌，让你笑，让你哭，让你把晚饭都吐出来。

English: But... I 'aint got the heart to sing 'em now.
Chinese: 可如今……我没那个心情唱了。

English: I've been sailing with Vela for years. Me, Vela and Basalt - in the beginning it was just ((us)), but by the end I couldn't keep count of our number.
Chinese: 我和薇拉同船航行了很多年。我、薇拉和巴索特——起初只有((我们几个))，到最后人数多得我都数不过来。

English: Vela always had a way with people, y'know? There was this glint in her eye. She'd give you this thin smile, and stare right at you. Like she really ((knew)) you. And she'd tell you exactly - ((exactly)) what you needed to hear.
Chinese: 薇拉天生懂人心，你知道吗？她眼里有光。她会给你一个浅浅的笑，直直望着你。仿佛她真的((懂))你。而且她总能一字不差——((一字不差))——说出你最想听的话。

English: <<She smiles to herself.>> She had the whole company believing they were gonna change the skyrealms. Make a ((difference)) - or at least, get filthy rich tryin'.
Chinese: <<她自己笑了。>>她让整个佣兵团都相信他们将改变天空领域。干出一番((名堂))——至少，也能在尝试中大捞一笔。

English: But sometimes I wonder if she even believed it herself. Most couldn't see it, but I could tell she was hurting. When we heard of the Cradle, she latched onto it like... like it could fix that ((broken)) thing inside her.
Chinese: 但有时我怀疑她自己信不信。大多数人看不出来，可我看得出她在受煎熬。听说摇篮的消息后，她一下就扑了上去，仿佛……仿佛它能修好她心里那件((破碎))的东西。

English: I just hope I did the right thing, in trying to stop her. 'Cos gods know, I still... I still think of the people we lost in that mutiny.
Chinese: 我只求当年试图拦她是对的。因为天知道，我至今……至今还想着哗变里失去的那些人。

English: Okay, that's all I wanted to know.
Chinese: 好，我想知道的就是这些。

English: Alright.
Chinese: 好吧。

English: That sure is a big suit of armour.
Chinese: 这身铠甲可真够大的。

English: Hah, this old thing? ##<<She raises an arm. As the armour plates clink and shift, you notice intricate mechanisms moving beneath.>>
Chinese: 哈，这老古董？##<<她抬起手臂。甲片铿锵错动间，你看见下面精密的机括在运转。>>

English: Yeah, they don't make 'em like this anymore. The Emberians would inscribe their metal with cipher, too intricate to see with the naked eye; but it makes the stuff stronger than it has any right to be.
Chinese: 是啊，现在没人做得出这种东西了。余烬人会在金属上錾刻密文，精细到肉眼难辨；却能让材料硬得离谱。

English: In the early days, we'd raid Emberian ruins - often just Vela and me. A lot of 'em were already cleared out by raiders, or so you'd ((think)), but... I somehow ((knew)) there were things still hidden. A lever there, a switch here, a few taps on a keypad...
Chinese: 早年间，我们常去光顾余烬遗迹——常常只有薇拉和我。很多地方早被盗掘者扫荡一空，至少你((会这么以为))，但……我总能莫名((知道))还有什么藏着。那边有个拉杆，这边有个开关，在键盘上敲几下……

English: Folk often wondered how we'd scored such big hauls. Used to say we were lucky, or using forbidden Wikkan charms, or something. ##<<She shrugs.>> Suppose there's ((some)) good things about being born from a tube.
Chinese: 人们总琢磨我们怎么捞到这么大的油水。有人说是运气，有人说我们用维坎的禁咒，什么的。##<<她耸耸肩。>>大概从管子里生出来也有((那么点))好处吧。

English: Actually, never mind.
Chinese: 其实，算了。

English: Not a problem.
Chinese: 没事。

English: <<The Endless is cleaning a handful of teeth with a dirty rag.>> ##((Howth ith goin')), bweather?
Chinese: <<那个无尽者正用一块脏抹布擦着一把牙齿。>>##((咋、咋样啊))，喘、喘气儿的？

English: Uh, excuse me?
Chinese: 呃，打扰一下？

English: What are you doing with those teeth?
Chinese: 你拿那些牙齿干什么？

English: <<The man picks up the teeth, one-by-one, and slots them into his gums with a squelch.>> ##Ah, sorry breather - I was cleanin' my teeth.
Chinese: <<那人把牙齿一颗颗捡起，吧唧吧唧地按回牙床。>>##啊，抱歉啊呼吸者——我刚才在刷牙。

English: <<He smiles at you. Despite his efforts, his teeth don't look very clean.>>
Chinese: <<他朝你微笑。虽然费了半天劲，他的牙看上去也不怎么干净。>>

English: Not often we get one o' your kind snooping around [[Cadaver Keep.]] What can I do ye for?
Chinese: 你们这路人来[[尸骸要塞]]转悠的可不多见。有什么能为你效劳的？

English: What is this place?
Chinese: 这地方是什么？

English: Why, this is the stronghold of the [[Cadavers]], breather! ##Y'see, years ago - when the [[Cadaver Crusades]] were in full swing - we used this fortress to launch our assaults on the living.
Chinese: 嘿，这里是[[尸骸派]]的老巢，呼吸者！##你瞧，很多年前——[[尸骸十字军]]打得热火朝天的时候——我们就是从这座堡垒出动，去讨伐活人的。

English: Our knights would haul in wagons of mortals - squirming and writhing together in their own filth. In those days, we'd have banquets of flesh every night - our goblets running with warm blood!
Chinese: 我们的骑士一车车地拖运凡人——让他们在自己污物里扭作一团。那时候，我们夜夜开血肉宴席——高脚杯里淌满温热的鲜血！

English: <<He smiles at you, seemingly unaware that this might make you uncomfortable.>>
Chinese: <<他朝你微笑，似乎全然没意识到这可能让你不舒服。>>

English: But... you don't eat mortals ((anymore))... right?
Chinese: 但……你们现在((不吃))凡人了……对吧？

English: Oh of ((course)) not, breather. By decree of the Queen, we eat only the mindless meat from Penitent Thaw's [[Flesh Farms.]]
Chinese: 哦((当然))不吃了，呼吸者。奉女王法令，我们只吃忏悔者·索[[血肉农场]]产的无意识血肉。

English: Now - if you hear an Endless boastin' about how he's been eatin' the ((thinkin' stuff)) - they didn't get it from ((us)), y'hear? No siree - we've nothin' to do with them black market shenanigans...
Chinese: 还有——你要是听见哪个无尽者吹嘘自己吃过((会思考的玩意儿))——那可不是从((我们这儿))弄的，听见没？绝对不是——黑市那些勾当我们半点关系都没有……

English: Where does that black market meat come from?
Chinese: 那黑市血肉是从哪来的？

English: The thinkin' stuff? Now, not that ((I'd)) know, breather - but if I were to take a ((wild guess)) - I'd say you could get livin' flesh from all sortsa places these days.
Chinese: 会思考的玩意儿？咳，我((可))不知道，呼吸者——不过要我((瞎猜))的话——如今弄到活人血肉的路子多得是。

English: A ((smart)) Endless would broker deals with all sorts of unscrupulous mortal types. Trade with smugglers an' ruffians for corpses - or with morticians who have a... ((surplus)) of clients.
Chinese: 一个((精明))的无尽者会跟各种没底线的凡人做买卖。跟走私犯和匪徒换尸体——或者跟那些……((客源过剩))的殡葬商打交道。

English: Of course, what with the Queen 'avin outlawed all such flesh trade - Flesh Farms notwithstandin' - I wouldn't really know anythin' about any of this. ((Naturally.))
Chinese: 当然了，女王把这类血肉买卖全禁了——血肉农场除外——这些事我真是一概不知情。((自然而然的。))

English: Let me ask you something else.
Chinese: 我问点别的。

English: Sure thing, breather.
Chinese: 尽管问，呼吸者。

English: Can you lower the drawbridge for me?
Chinese: 能帮我放下吊桥吗？

English: The drawbridge is already down, breather.
Chinese: 吊桥已经放下来了，呼吸者。

English: <<He shifts, suddenly nervous.>> Ah, and why'd ye be lookin' to go ((in there)), breather? Nothing for mortals behind that drawbridge, I assure you!
Chinese: <<他扭动了一下，突然紧张起来。>>啊，你想去((那里面))做什么，呼吸者？吊桥后面可没有凡人能享用的东西，我向你保证！

English: @@You think just because I'm mortal, I can't share your... interests?
Chinese: @@你以为凡人就体会不了你们的……爱好？

English: %% <<The Endless eyes you up and down.>> Hmph, well I'll be. A mortal with... ((deviant)) tastes. Now I've seen it all...
Chinese: %% <<无尽者上下打量你。>>嚯，真是开了眼了。一个品味如此……((猎奇))的凡人。这下什么怪事都见全了……

English: Very well - we've no reason to turn away y'er coin. I'll call for 'em to lower the bridge.
Chinese: 很好——钱没有拒收的道理。我叫人放桥。

English: && Sorry, breather, I jes' can't go letting in mortals like yerself into the Keep. Would go against all sort'a traditions.
Chinese: && 抱歉了呼吸者，放你这样的凡人进出要塞，这事我真干不了。坏了多少老规矩啊。

English: Okay, I'll take your word for it.
Chinese: 好吧，就信你的话。

English: That's smart, breather.
Chinese: 这就对了，呼吸者。

English: I'll leave you to your... business.
Chinese: 不打扰你的……营生了。

English: <<The brutish endless blinks at you.>> ##Stop right there. I'm not allowed to let anyone down into [[meat processing.]] An' I'm not allowed to tell anyone it's called [[meat processing]].
Chinese: <<那个粗壮的无尽者朝你眨眨眼。>>##站住。谁都不许进[[肉类加工区]]。而且谁问我我都不许说这里叫[[肉类加工区]]。

English: Uh... you're doing a real good job there.
Chinese: 呃……你这岗站得是真尽责。

English: <<The endless grins, shamelessly.>>
Chinese: <<无尽者毫不害臊地咧嘴笑。>>

English: I'd like to enter the door, please.
Chinese: 我想进这扇门。

English: <<The brute shakes his head.>> Nu-uh. Only [[meat]] is allowed down there.
Chinese: <<壮汉摇头。>>不行。下面只许[[肉]]进。

English: @@I ((am)) the meat. Look at me! Nice an' fleshy...
Chinese: @@我((就是))肉。看看我！多新鲜多水灵……

English: %% Never met such ((friendly)) meat before. But okay then, you can go down.
Chinese: %% 从没见过这么((热情))的肉。行吧，你可以下去。

English: && <<The brute squints at you.>> If you're ((meat)), why are you talkin' and smilin'? Nu-uh, this don't seem right.
Chinese: && <<壮汉眯眼打量你。>>你要是((肉))，怎么会说话还会笑？不行，这事不对劲。

English: I'm going down whether you like it or not.
Chinese: 不管你乐不乐意，我都要下去。

English: <<The brute draws his sword.>>
Chinese: <<壮汉拔出了剑。>>

English: I'll leave you to it.
Chinese: 不打扰你了。

English: You can go down, then.
Chinese: 那你下去吧。

English: <<The Endless sweeps the ground with his rake, though he just seems to be moving around the dirt.>>
Chinese: <<无尽者用耙子扫着地，虽然他看起来只是把土挪来挪去。>>

English: <<As you approach, he looks startled.>> Ah, breather, didn't notice you there. Not often I see yer kind around.
Chinese: <<你走近时，他吓了一跳。>>啊，呼吸者，没看见你在那儿。你们这类人可不常来。

English: Who are you?
Chinese: 你是谁？

English: Who am I? Well, that's a good question. I've been wonderin' myself, lately. I seem to 'ave forgotten my name a few decades back...
Chinese: 我是谁？嗯，好问题。最近我自己也在琢磨。几十年前我好像把自己的名字给忘了……

English: Was it Yhem? Or Gluppus, perhaps? Ah, it's all a jumble...
Chinese: 是伊赫姆？还是格鲁普斯？唉，全搅成一团了……

English: Anyways, I'm the groundskeeper for the [[Duchess]]. At least, I ((think)) I am. Not seen the girl for a good century or so, an' I'm starting to wonder if I made the whole thing up...
Chinese: 反正，我是[[女公爵]]的园丁。至少我((觉得))是。这姑娘足有一个世纪没露面了，我都开始怀疑这差事是不是我瞎编的……

English: What is this place?
Chinese: 这地方是什么？

English: Time ago, before we lot called ourselves Endless, these islands were known as [[Verdant.]] Our houses were made from beautiful wood - not those huge stone tombs you see today.
Chinese: 好久以前，还没轮到我们这帮人自称无尽者的时候，这些岛屿叫做[[蔓绿]]。那时的房子是漂亮木头盖的——不像你今天看到的那些大石头坟。

English: This part o' the island is the only place left where you can see a remnant of how things used to be. The rest of it has all rotted away.
Chinese: 岛的这一角是仅剩还能看出旧时光模样的地方。其余的全烂没了。

English: It's also where the [[Duchess]] lives, but she never leaves her manor.
Chinese: [[女公爵]]也住这一带，但她从不离开庄园。

English: Can I visit the Duchess?
Chinese: 我能去拜访女公爵吗？

English: You can sure ((try.)) Her [[family manor]] is over yonder, but it's mostly just a ruin, now - and she's hidden the entrance with a spell. You'll have to figure out how to get across, somehow...
Chinese: 你可以((试试。))她的[[家族庄园]]就在那边，不过现在基本就是片废墟——而且她用咒语把入口藏起来了。怎么过去，你得自己想法子……

English: She's also enchanted a bunch of [[skeletons]] to patrol the place, so watch yer step. They can't really ((think)) - it's just a spell holding 'em together - so they won't hesitate to swipe at ya.
Chinese: 她还附魔了一群[[骷髅]]在四处巡逻，脚下留神。它们其实((不会思考))——只是咒语把骨头拼在一块儿——砍你可不带犹豫的。

English: Thanks. I'll be going.
Chinese: 谢了。我先走了。

English: <<Hanging in the gloom, the Endless woman is engrossed in ritual. She hisses violent, unfamiliar words while her hands trace sparks of light through the air, illuminating the books and the dust around her.>>
Chinese: <<晦暗中，那位无尽者女子正沉浸于仪式。她嘶声念着暴烈而陌生的词句，双手在空中划出点点光屑，照亮周身的书卷与尘埃。>>

English: Uh, hello?
Chinese: 呃，你好？

English: ((Bow politely.))
Chinese: ((礼貌地鞠躬。))

English: ((Take your leave.))
Chinese: ((告辞离开。))

English: <<The woman seems oblivious to your presence, her face inscrutable behind her mask. She continues to mutter esoteric phrases while sculpting glyphs of light.>>
Chinese: <<那女人似乎没有察觉你的存在，面具后的脸庞高深莫测。她继续低声念诵着玄奥的词句，指尖雕琢着光的符文。>>

English: What are you doing?
Chinese: 你在做什么？

English: You're, uh... clearly busy, but...
Chinese: 你，呃……看起来很忙，不过……

English: <<She screams, her voice seething with a wave of magical energy that sends the books crashing to the floor.>>
Chinese: <<她尖啸一声，声音里翻涌的魔法能量激荡开来，把书震得满地乱滚。>>

English: Do you know how ((difficult)) it is to weave parallel cipher syntax while some ((idiot)) is talking in your ear?
Chinese: 你知道一边编((并行))密文语法、一边有个((白痴))在耳边说话有多难吗？

English: <<She groans in frustration.>> ##I'm sorry. I'm in the middle of a... [[family crisis]], and you caught me trying to conjugate a pair of superlatives. Sometimes I just ((hate)) cipher semiotics.
Chinese: <<她懊恼地呻吟。>>##抱歉。我正陷在一场……[[家庭危机]]里，又被你撞见我在给两个最高级变位。有时候我真((恨))密文符号学。

English: Well, I suppose if you bypassed my security measures, you must have come here for a ((reason.)) <<She studies you a moment.>> ##You're not a Cadaver assassin, are you? Sent by that infernal Rhydder to try and lop off my head, or somesuch?
Chinese: 唔，我想，既然你能绕过我的安防措施，你上门总归有((什么目的。))<<她端详了你片刻。>>##你不是尸骸派刺客吧？是不是那个可恶的里德尔派你来取我人头的？

English: No, I'm not an assassin.
Chinese: 不，我不是刺客。

English: <<She studies you a moment.>> Well, that's exactly what an assassin would say. I have to be ((sure...))
Chinese: <<她端详了你片刻。>>嗯，刺客恰恰就会这么说。我必须((确认……))

English: <Lie> Yes, I'm an assassin.
Chinese: <撒谎>对，我就是刺客。

English: <<She studies you a moment.>> A ((mortal)) Cadaver? I've seen stranger things... ##But, I have to be sure.
Chinese: <<她端详了你片刻。>>一个((凡人))尸骸派？更奇怪的事我也见过……##不过，我必须确认。

English: Uh... what's a Cadaver?
Chinese: 呃……尸骸派是什么？
