English: <<She studies you a moment.>> Well, your ignorance ((seems)) convincing... ##But, I have to be sure.
Chinese: <<她端详了你片刻。>>唔，你这份无知((倒像))是真的……##不过，我必须确认。

English: I'm just going to have a poke around in your mind. You may feel some... ((tingling)) in your brain, but don't worry - this rarely leads to ((permanent)) damage.
Chinese: 我就在你脑子里随便翻翻。你可能会觉得脑子里有点……((发麻))，但别担心——很少会造成((永久))损伤。

English: Wait, don't you da--
Chinese: 等等，你可别——

English: Did you say ((perma))--
Chinese: 你刚才是说((永久))——

English: <<A pain slices through your head, followed by a plethora of discomforting feelings. Your senses are jumbled; you hear smells, taste sights, breathe sounds. Everything warps, and you feel nauseous. >>
Chinese: <<一阵剧痛劈开你的头颅，随之而来的是铺天盖地的错乱感受。你的感官搅成了一团：你听见气味，尝到景象，呼吸着声音。万物扭曲，你一阵反胃。>>

English: <<But then, you find yourself under the sharp light of your home star. Your hand grips a bloodied branch. A child cowers before you, weeping in the mud.>>
Chinese: <<紧接着，你发现自己站在家乡恒星刺目的光芒下。你手里攥着一根染血的树枝。一个孩子缩在你面前，在泥地里哭泣。>>

English: <<Yes, you remember - this was the first real fight you ever won, when you were six years young...>>
Chinese: <<是的，你想起来了——这是你人生第一场真正打赢的架，那年你六岁……>>

English: <<Her voice cuts through your dream.>> ##So, you were always the ((violent)) sort, eh mortal?
Chinese: <<她的声音刺破你的梦境。>>##原来你向来是((崇尚暴力))的那种人，嗯，凡人？

English: <<But then, you find yourself back in your family home; the warm light of your neuron star filtering through tall windows, making the ornaments glint. You sit, playing with toys, as your nanny smiles.>>
Chinese: <<紧接着，你发现自己回到了童年的家；神经元星温暖的光透过高窗洒进来，照得摆饰闪闪发亮。你坐在那里玩玩具，保姆在一旁微笑。>>

English: <<Yes, you remember - the comfort of home, before you knew of the world's terrors...>>
Chinese: <<是的，你想起来了——家的温暖，那时你还不知道世界的恐怖……>>

English: <<Her voice cuts through your dream.>> ##Ah, mortal - you were born a noble? I understand that gilded cage all too well.
Chinese: <<她的声音刺破你的梦境。>>##啊，凡人——你生来就是贵族？那种镀金的鸟笼，我再懂不过了。

English: <<But then, you find yourself cowering in the filth of an alleyway, small and frightened. A man leers over you, raising his sword. You have but a moment to clasp the shard of broken glass and lunge at his belly...>>
Chinese: <<紧接着，你发现自己蜷缩在肮脏的小巷里，渺小而惊恐。一个男人俯视着你，举起了剑。你只有一瞬间的工夫抓起碎玻璃片，刺向他的腹部……>>

English: <<Yes, you remember - you were six years young. Just another worthless urchin in the city sprawl. The things you did to survive... >>
Chinese: <<是的，你想起来了——那年你六岁。不过是城市泥沼里又一个不值钱的野孩子。为了活下去，你做过什么……>>

English: <<Her voice cuts through your dream.>> ##You've had a tough life, mortal. I'm... sorry.
Chinese: <<她的声音刺破你的梦境。>>##你活得不容易，凡人。我……很抱歉。

English: <<But then, you find yourself hunched over a huge book in the candlelight, praying that your master won't find you with this forbidden tome. You run your hand over the ink, and utter a few words. Your throat crackles with magical energy, and you are suddenly very afraid...>>
Chinese: <<紧接着，你发现自己借着烛光伏在一本巨著上，祈祷主人别发现你翻看这部禁书。你抚过墨迹，念出几个词。你的喉咙噼啪爆出魔法能量，你突然害怕极了……>>

English: <<Yes, you remember - you were six years young. A child-scholar, taking your first tentative steps into the arcane.>>
Chinese: <<是的，你想起来了——那年你六岁。一个小小学者，怯生生地迈出踏入奥秘的第一步。>>

English: <<Her voice cuts through your dream.>> ##A youth of study, mortal? We are kindred spirits, you and I.
Chinese: <<她的声音刺破你的梦境。>>##在书堆里度过的童年，凡人？你我是同类人。

English: But this isn't enough. I need ((more)).
Chinese: 但这还不够。我需要((更多))。

English: <<Another wave of nausea. Reality churns around you, until you wake in an Inquisition prison cell; the smell of rust and shit filling your nostrils.>>
Chinese: <<又是一阵反胃。现实在你周围翻搅，直到你在一间宗教裁判所的牢房里醒来；铁锈和粪便的气味灌满鼻腔。>>

English: So that's it, eh? You're with those Inquisition bastards. But you're not a player; just some pawn in their scheming, blackmailed with the threat of oblivion. How ((pitiful.))
Chinese: 原来是这么回事，嗯？你是那些宗教裁判所混蛋的人。可惜你算不上棋手，只是他们阴谋里的一枚小卒，被抹除的威胁拿捏着。真((可怜。))

English: <<Once more you're submerged in memory. You see Vela's ship drifting away from you; and with it, your only hope of salvation.>>
Chinese: <<你再度沉入记忆。你看见薇拉的船缓缓离你而去；连同你唯一的得救希望一起。>>

English: Ah, so it's ((Vela)) you're after. I sailed with her for ten years - even called myself a Dark Star. But I assume you knew that?
Chinese: 啊，原来你追的是((薇拉))。我和她并肩航行了十年——还自称过黑星呢。不过，你应该早就知道了吧？

English: ((Cough.)) Basalt... sent me.
Chinese: ((咳。))是巴索特……派我来的。

English: Ah, so that old seaslug's still with us? I must admit, I always thought the drink would kill him. ##But to hear he's working with the ((Inquisition,)) after all we've been through...?
Chinese: 啊，那头老海蛞蝓还活着呢？不得不承认，我一直以为酒会先要了他的命。##可听说他居然给((宗教裁判所))办事，毕竟我们也算共过患难……？

English: ((Cough.)) I had... a hunch.
Chinese: ((咳。))我只是……有预感。

English: ((Cough.)) I had... no idea.
Chinese: ((咳。))我……完全不知情。

English: Well, this only deepens my suspicions. ##So tell me, do you ((kill)) for your masters? Do you take the lives of others, to preserve your own?
Chinese: 哼，这只会加深我的疑心。##告诉我，你替你的主子们((杀过人))吗？你可曾为了保全自己，夺走他人的性命？

English: I'll kill anyone... who stands in my way.
Chinese: 谁挡我的路……我就杀谁。

English: Oh, of ((course.)) I'm sure you're extremely tough, and I should cower in fear, and all the rest. But let's see the truth, shall we?
Chinese: 哦，((当然。))我相信你勇武非凡，我理应吓得瑟瑟发抖，诸如此类。不过，还是看看真相吧，如何？

English: Only in self defence... do I draw my sword.
Chinese: 唯有自卫……我才会拔剑。

English: Oh, how noble! How valiant! I'm ((humbled)) by your chivalry, excetera. But let's see the truth, shall we?
Chinese: 哦，多么高尚！多么英勇！你的骑士风度令我((自愧不如))，等等等等。不过，还是看看真相吧，如何？

English: I avoid conflict... wherever I can.
Chinese: 只要有可能……我都会避开冲突。

English: So you're either a pacifist, a coward - or a liar. Let's see the truth, shall we?
Chinese: 这么说，你要么是和平主义者，要么是懦夫——要么是骗子。还是看看真相吧，如何？

English: <<Your mind reels once more. You see the men and monsters who've stood in your way; and how you've slipped past, sword sheathed, every single time.>>
Chinese: <<你的心智再度翻腾。你看见那些拦路的人和怪物；也看见自己每一次都全身而退，剑未出鞘。>>

English: Hm, so you spoke the truth, mortal? You really ((haven't)) taken a single life. I must admit, I'm impressed.
Chinese: 嗯，你说的竟是实话，凡人？你还真的一条命都((没))取过。不得不承认，我有点佩服。

English: Hah, so you lied! You're not a killer at all. In fact you haven't taken a ((single)) life. I must admit, to come all this way? I'm impressed.
Chinese: 哈，原来你撒谎了！你根本不是杀手。事实上你一条命都((没))取过。不得不承认，千里迢迢走到这一步？我有点佩服。

English: <<Your mind reels once more. You see the men and monsters who've stood in your way; and how you've slipped past, wherever possible. ##The few times when your hand has been forced, you remember the feeling of your blade sinking into flesh; and those final, agonising death cries...>>
Chinese: <<你的心智再度翻腾。你看见那些拦路的人和怪物；也看见自己尽可能地绕道而行。##少数几次被逼出手时，你记得剑刃没入血肉的触感；还有那临死前痛苦的哀嚎……>>

English: Hm, so you're the honest sort, mortal. The lives you've taken have been few; you seem to only draw your blade when strictly necessary. I must admit, I respect you for that.
Chinese: 嗯，你倒是个诚实人，凡人。你取过的命寥寥无几；似乎只有万不得已时才肯拔剑。不得不承认，就冲这个我敬你几分。

English: Aha, so you're not as bloodthirsty as you make out! It's just an ((act.)) You've taken very few lives. ##I must admit, I respect you for that.
Chinese: 啊哈，原来你没装得那么嗜血！那不过是((演的。))你取过的命极少。##不得不承认，就冲这个我敬你几分。

English: <<Your mind reels once more. You see the men and monsters who've stood in your way; and how you've clashed swords, evaded their blows; buried your steel into their flesh. You've tasted blood more times than you care to remember, your hands forever stained.>>
Chinese: <<你的心智再度翻腾。你看见那些拦路的人和怪物；也看见自己与他们刀剑相向、闪避他们的攻击、把钢铁送进他们的血肉。你染血次数多得不愿回想，双手永远洗不干净。>>

English: You lied, mortal. You're a ((killer)) through and through. The blood you've spilled seeps through these isles, even now.
Chinese: 你撒谎了，凡人。你是个彻头彻尾的((杀手))。你洒下的血至今仍渗在这些群岛的泥土里。

English: So you're honest, at least. You're a ((killer)) through and through. The blood you've spilled seeps through these isles, even now.
Chinese: 至少你还算诚实。你是个彻头彻尾的((杀手))。你洒下的血至今仍渗在这些群岛的泥土里。

English: <<Your mind reels once more. You see the men and monsters who've stood in your way; and how you've clashed swords, evaded their blows; buried your steel into their flesh. You remember the chaos, the thrill; the ((bloodlust.)) The truth is, you ((enjoy)) it.>>
Chinese: <<你的心智再度翻腾。你看见那些拦路的人和怪物；也看见自己与他们刀剑相向、闪避他们的攻击、把钢铁送进他们的血肉。你记得那份混乱、那份战栗；那份((嗜血欲。))事实是，你((乐在其中。))>>

English: <<She seems taken aback.>> Mortal, you -- you're a ((monster.)) The blood that you've spilled? Nobody could ever atone for such wanton violence... ##Though I suppose I have no right to judge you. My conscience is... ((hardly)) clear.
Chinese: <<她似乎吓了一跳。>>凡人，你——你是个((怪物。))你洒下的那些血？这样肆意的暴行，谁都无法赎清……##不过我大概也没资格审判你。我的良心也……((不太))干净。

English: Hmm, but what's this? <<Searing pain; and you see the Flesh Farm screaming in agony. You see Rhydder, his cruel gaze; and you remember the deal you made...>>
Chinese: 嗯，这是什么？<<灼痛袭来；你看见血肉农场在痛苦中尖啸。你看见里德尔，他残忍的目光；你想起了自己做的交易……>>

English: Ah, so you ((are)) in league with the Cadavers! Your actions, whether in spite or folly, have cast a dark shadow on this island... ##...and yet, I see nothing to show that you mean ((me)) harm.
Chinese: 啊，原来你((真的))和尸骸派有勾结！你的所作所为，无论是恶意还是愚蠢，都给这座岛蒙上了阴影……##……不过，我没看出你有意害((我))。

English: Well, after scraping through your skull - it seems there's nothing to suggest you're after my head.
Chinese: 嗯，把你脑壳里里外外刮了一遍——看来没有迹象表明你在打我脑袋的主意。

English: And from what I've seen, there's nothing to suggest you're after my head.
Chinese: 而且据我所见，没有迹象表明你在打我脑袋的主意。

English: <<She sighs.>> ##I'll spare you the torment of further mind probes, mortal. Any more and your brain could burst - and I don't want to clean ((that)) up.
Chinese: <<她叹了口气。>>##我就不再用读心折磨你了，凡人。再来几次你的脑子可能就炸了——那种((烂摊子))我可不想收拾。

English: Ah, but where are my manners? We've learned all about ((you)), but I've not introduced myself. ##((She feigns a pompous bow.)) The [[Duchess]], at your service.
Chinese: 啊，瞧我这礼仪。我们把你((里里外外))都摸清了，我却还没自报家门。##((她装腔作势地行了个礼。))[[女公爵]]愿为你效劳。

English: Well, ((really)) I am Philomena Caveridge, Duchess of Vestalshire - but that's quite the mouthful, eh?
Chinese: 其实呢，((正经说))我是菲洛米娜·卡弗里奇，维斯塔尔郡女公爵——不过这名字太拗口了，对吧？

English: If you'd arrived about six centuries ago, I would have greeted you into a bustling household - alive with music and merriment. My servants would have offered refreshment, I would have introduced you to my five darling children...
Chinese: 要是你在六百年前登门，我会把你迎进一个热闹的宅邸——音乐悠扬、笑语盈门。仆人们会奉上茶点，我还会向你引荐我五个心爱的孩子……

English: <<She chuckles wearily.>> Ah, how is it that six hundred years can pass so ((quickly?)) ##Now, I drift in this cold tomb while my estate lies in decay...
Chinese: <<她疲惫地轻笑。>>啊，六百年怎会过得如此((之快？))##如今，我在这冰冷的坟墓里飘荡，家业早已朽坏……

English: It sounds like you miss your former life.
Chinese: 听起来你很怀念从前的生活。

English: There's not an Endless around who doesn't. But for most of us, it's hard to think of our mortal lives without opening the door to our... ((demons)).
Chinese: 无尽者里没有谁不怀念。但对大多数人来说，一想起凡人岁月，就会打开通往自己……((心魔))的门。

English: Such inherited wealth is abhorrent.
Chinese: 这种世袭的财富令人作呕。

English: I'm inclined to agree with you, mortal. In my youth I resented my birthright; as the eldest child I was expected to marry, and produce heirs; when all I really wanted to pursue was my studies.
Chinese: 我倒倾向于同意你，凡人。年轻时我也怨恨自己的出身；身为长女，我被指望结婚生子、延续血脉，而我真正想追求的只有学问。

English: But if the privilege of those years warranted some sort of ((debt)), I paid it a thousand times over.
Chinese: 不过，如果说那些年的荣华欠下了某种((债))，我早已千倍偿还。

English: You see, I became Duchess the day my father died, in [[the Great Devouring.]] Do you know what that was?
Chinese: 要知道，我父亲死在[[大吞噬]]里的那一天，我就成了女公爵。你知道那是什么吗？

English: Yes.
Chinese: 知道。

English: Then you will know it is the darkest stain on my people's history. The Endless were born with an insatiable hunger. For decades we ((feasted)) upon those we once called kin.
Chinese: 那你就该知道，那是我族历史上最黑暗的污点。无尽者生来便怀有永不餍足的饥渴。几十年间，我们((大啖))曾称其为血亲之人。

English: No.
Chinese: 不知道。

English: Six hundred and thirty-five years ago, the Endless were born from the hubris and folly of our king. His wretched spell twisted half of the realm into this accursed form. We were born anew - frenzied and ((hungry)).
Chinese: 六百三十五年前，无尽者因我们国王的傲慢与愚蠢而诞生。他那拙劣的法术把半个王国扭曲成了这副受诅咒的模样。我们获得新生——癫狂而((饥饿))。

English: So the realm of Verdant - for that is what it was called, then - ((ate)) itself. ## Friends and family, who were dining merrily together in the morn, were ((eating)) each other by the eve.
Chinese: 于是蔓绿王国——那时它还叫这个名字——((吞食))了它自己。##清晨还围坐欢宴的亲朋，入夜就((互相))吞食。

English: And my family was no different. ##I was five and thirty years of age, when it happened. I had a husband. Five beautiful children...
Chinese: 我的家人也没能幸免。##事发那年，我三十五岁。我有丈夫。五个可爱的孩子……

English: You know the cruellest thing? There was a part of us that ((knew)) what was happening. As I tore into my husband's flesh, I howled not in anger -  but in sorrow. As my daughter gorged upon the bowels of her brother, I saw the tears streaming down her face...
Chinese: 你知道最残忍的是什么吗？我们之中仍有一部分((明白))正在发生什么。当我撕咬丈夫的血肉，我哀嚎不是因为愤怒——而是悲恸。当我女儿吞食她兄弟的内脏，我看见泪水淌了满脸……

English: And as I picked up my infant son, not three months old - I wanted to hold him. To ((kiss)) him. I never meant to... ##<<Her voice croaks, and she is silent a moment.>>
Chinese: 当我抱起我不满三个月的小儿子——我只想抱紧他。想((亲亲))他。我从没想过要……##<<她的声音嘶哑下来，沉默了片刻。>>

English: I'm so sorry.
Chinese: 我很难过。

English: Save your tears, mortal. There are some things you will ((never)) understand.
Chinese: 收起你的眼泪吧，凡人。有些事你永远((不会))懂。

English: You're a monster.
Chinese: 你是个怪物。

English: I won't deny it.
Chinese: 我不否认。

English: ((Say nothing.))
Chinese: ((一言不发。))

English: To be Endless is to live with a terrible guilt. It is the same for ((all)) of us. But while most find comfort in the rituals and traditions of old, I find them ((suffocating))...
Chinese: 身为无尽者，就要背负可怕的罪孽活着。我们((人人))皆然。不过，多数人能从古老的仪式与传统中寻得慰藉，我却只觉得((窒息))……

English: <<She chuckles.>> Ah, but there I go again, dredging up the past. I think it's why I stopped getting invited to all those mausoleum balls.
Chinese: <<她轻笑。>>唉，我又来了，翻这些陈年旧账。我猜这就是后来陵墓舞会都不请我的原因。

English: So tell me, mortal - this... ((hunt)) for Vela. What do you hope to accomplish?
Chinese: 那么告诉我，凡人——这场……((追捕))薇拉的行动。你想达成什么？

English: Can't you just read my mind?
Chinese: 你直接读我的心不就行了？

English: Well, of course I ((could)), but it's terribly impolite. And now I know you're not after my head, you can lie all you wish; it bothers me not.
Chinese: 我((当然))可以，但那太不礼貌了。何况我已知道你不是来取我人头的，随你怎么撒谎，我都无所谓。

English: I must stop her from destroying the world.
Chinese: 我必须阻止她毁灭世界。

English: Hmm. The world is at stake, and you would save it? ##Admirable, but of course - that's not how ((she)) sees it.
Chinese: 唔。世界危在旦夕，而你要拯救它？##可敬。当然了——((她))可不这么看。

English: I want to help her to save the world.
Chinese: 我想帮她拯救世界。

English: Ah, so you've been enticed by her revolutionary zeal, have you?
Chinese: 啊，你被她的革命热忱蛊惑了，是吧？

English: She dies, I get my freedom. Simple.
Chinese: 她死，我自由。就这么简单。

English: Ah, self preservation - no truer motivation than that. But still, when the time comes, you may have a... choice to make.
Chinese: 啊，明哲保身——没有比这更真实的动机了。不过，到时候，你也许要做个……抉择。

English: I wonder - do you understand what's ((truly)) at stake?
Chinese: 我倒想问——你可明白((真正))押在上面的是什么？

English: There is a hidden language to the universe, mortal. A web of signs and signifiers which establish the very rules by which we live. ##And Vela? She wants to change it. She wants to change ((reality)) itself, to create a new world.
Chinese: 宇宙有一门隐秘的语言，凡人。一张由符号与能指织成的网，确立着我们生活的根本法则。##而薇拉？她想改写它。她想改变((现实))本身，创造一个新世界。

English: How would that work?
Chinese: 那要怎么做到？

English: I never was one for cipher semiotics. Can we get to the point?
Chinese: 我对密文符号学一向不来电。能说重点吗？

English: When we cast a cipher spell, we are speaking in the hidden language of the universe.
Chinese: 我们施展密文法术时，就是在用宇宙的隐秘语言说话。

English: But the ((rules?)) The grammar, the syntax, the signs themselves? All of us, from the humble scribe to the powerful cipher wizard, must adhere to these constraints. When we don't? There are often... ((dire)) consequences.
Chinese: 可那些((法则))呢？语法、句法、符号本身？从卑微软工到强大的密文法师，人人都必须遵守这些约束。一旦违逆？后果往往……((不堪设想))。

English: Like the Endless.
Chinese: 就像无尽者这样。

English: <<She nods.>> Exactly. The spell cast by our king, all those years ago, was ambitious indeed. The errors were likely minor - but when applied to a whole ((kingdom?)) It was catastrophic.
Chinese: <<她点头。>>正是。多年前我们的国王施展的那个法术，野心确实不小。错误也许微不足道——可一旦施加于整个((王国？))那就是灭顶之灾。

English: Like the Clockwork Kingdom.
Chinese: 就像发条王国那样。

English: <<She nods.>> I've seen what their monarch is doing with my own eyes. Rewriting minds, matter - whole ((swathes)) of reality. It will not end well for them.
Chinese: <<她点头。>>他们的君主在干什么，我亲眼见过。改写心智、物质——((大片大片))的现实。他们不会有好下场的。

English: Like the World Rend.
Chinese: 就像世界撕裂那样。

English: <<She nods.>> I don't know for ((sure)) what happened back then, but I witnessed it with my own eyes. ((Felt)) it in my mind. It was the most powerful spell I have witnessed, and it was caught in a syntax cascade. An infinite loop...
Chinese: <<她点头。>>我当时到底发生了什么，我((说不准))，但我亲眼目睹了。在脑海里((感受))过。那是我见过的最强大的法术，而且它陷入了语法级联。一个无限循环……

English: But if Vela's plan works, she'd make the impossible... ((possible.)) With a click of a finger, she could raise an empire. Make anyone ((truly)) immortal... even raise someone from the dead.
Chinese: 而如果薇拉的计划成功，她将让不可能……((成为可能。))打个响指，她就能崛起一个帝国。让任何人都((真正))不朽……甚至让死者复生。

English: Sounds incredible.
Chinese: 听起来不可思议。

English: Sounds dangerous.
Chinese: 听起来很危险。

English: Indeed. I have often weighed this dilemma in my mind. Would it be for good, or for ill?
Chinese: 是啊。我常在心里掂量这个两难之题。那是福，还是祸？

English: Very well. The heart of the matter is this...
Chinese: 好吧。问题的关键在于……

English: My people live in torment; our decaying bodies and haunted minds are prisons from which there is no escape. ##But... could Vela's plan be our salvation? Or would it subject the whole ((world)) to a similar torment?
Chinese: 我的族人活在煎熬之中；我们腐朽的躯体和饱受折磨的心智就是一座座无路可逃的牢狱。##可是……薇拉的计划会不会是我们的救赎？还是说，它会把整个((世界))拖进同样的煎熬？

English: I haven't yet made up my mind. But if I'm honest, I would like to be there... when the decision is made.
Chinese: 我还没有拿定主意。但说实话，当抉择落地之时……我想在场。

English: Then help me find Vela.
Chinese: 那就帮我找到薇拉。

English: It seems like our interests align.
Chinese: 看来我们的利益是一致的。

English: Alas, I'm somewhat ((engaged)) for the moment. I think I mentioned a... family crisis? ##[[My daughter]] has been stolen from me.
Chinese: 唉，我眼下有点((脱不开身))。我说过那场……家庭危机吧？##[[我女儿]]被人从我身边夺走了。

English: <<She closes her eyes.>> Her name is Ellyn. Of all my children, she alone remains. ##I can still see her, nine years young, holding my hand in the lush grass of Verdant. Everyone in the village knew that beaming smile.
Chinese: <<她闭上眼睛。>>她叫艾琳。我所有的孩子里，只剩她一个了。##我还能看见她，九岁的小人儿，在蔓绿青翠的草地上牵着我的手。全村人都认得她那张灿烂的笑脸。

English: She is nine years old, still - and the feeling of her hand in my own is all that keeps me clinging to this wretched existence. ##And now those ((damned)) [[Cadavers]] have taken her.
Chinese: 她至今仍是九岁——她握在我手里的那份触感，是我苟活于这凄惨存在的唯一支柱。##而现在，那些((该死的))[[尸骸派]]把她夺走了。

English: Can't you save her yourself?
Chinese: 你自己不能去救她吗？

English: Oh, I am trying, but the Cadavers are obsessive in their hatred of me. I must move slowly and carefully. ##<<She thinks for a moment.>>
Chinese: 唉，我一直在设法，但尸骸派恨我入骨、盯得死紧。我只能小心行事、徐徐图之。##<<她想了一会儿。>>

English: But ((you?)) As a stranger to the whole situation, you may very well have some advantage...
Chinese: 可((你呢？))你是局外人，说不定反而有几分优势……

English: I could try and rescue your daughter.
Chinese: 我可以试试救回你女儿。

English: You would, mortal? If you were to save her, I would truly be in your debt.
Chinese: 你愿意吗，凡人？若你能救她，我可就真欠你一份天大的人情了。

English: The Cadavers are a secretive bunch, but I've caught wind that one of them frequents the [[Rotten Coffin]] in [[Sepulchre.]] He wears a [[full suit of armour]], and holds a [[key]] that will grant access to the upper levels of Cadaver Keep.
Chinese: 尸骸派行事隐秘，但我听说他们中有一人是[[陵墓城]][[烂棺材]]酒馆的常客。他穿着[[一整套盔甲]]，手里握着一把能打开尸骸要塞上层区的[[钥匙]]。

English: He surely won't speak to me, nor my lackeys. But ((you?)) You're an outsider. More than that, you're a ((mortal.)) And Cadavers are ((very)) interested in mortals...
Chinese: 他肯定不会理会我，也不会理会我的仆从。可((你呢？))你是外人。更妙的是，你是个((凡人。))尸骸派对凡人可((非常))感兴趣……

English: Okay, I'll try and find her.
Chinese: 好，我会设法找到她。

English: Thank you, mortal.
Chinese: 谢谢你，凡人。

English: Wait... why are they interested in mortals?
Chinese: 等等……他们对凡人感兴趣是为什么？

English: Oh, did I... forget to mention?
Chinese: 哦，我……忘了说吗？

English: While most of the Endless eat from Penitent Thaw's mindless Flesh Farms, the Cadavers still believe it's their right to feast upon sentient flesh... like ((you.)) ##But don't worry. I'm sure you'll be fine.
Chinese: 大多数无尽者吃的是忏悔者·索的无意识血肉农场出产，尸骸派却仍坚信享用有意识血肉是他们的权利……比如((你))这样的。##不过别担心。你肯定不会有事的。

English: My daughter has a [[signet ring]] on her finger. Find her, and I'll help you track down Vela. You have my word.
Chinese: 我女儿手上戴着一枚[[印戒]]。找到她，我就帮你追查薇拉。我向你保证。

English: Greetings, mortal. How do you fare?
Chinese: 你好啊，凡人。近来如何？

English: How can I find your daughter, again?
Chinese: 再说一遍，我该怎么找你女儿？

English: Where exactly is Cadaver Keep?
Chinese: 尸骸要塞到底在哪？

English: The keep is the [[northern-most]] structure in the Endless Realm. Keep walking north, past [[Sepulchre]], and you can't miss it.
Chinese: 要塞是无尽领域[[最北端]]的建筑。一路向北，过了[[陵墓城]]，你不会错过的。

English: The front of [[Cadaver Keep]] is heavily guarded, but the fortifications are old and weathered - so you may be able to slip in through the walls, somewhere...
Chinese: [[尸骸要塞]]的正面守卫森严，但那些工事年久失修——找个地方，你也许能从墙缝里溜进去……

English: But remember - certain sections of the keep require a [[key]] that I don't possess. You'll need to procure one from the [[Cadaver]] in the [[Rotten Coffin]] pub to explore the whole thing.
Chinese: 但记住——要塞的某些区域需要一把我没有的[[钥匙]]。想探索全部，你得从[[烂棺材]]酒馆里那个[[尸骸派]]手上弄到一把。

English: About your daughter...
Chinese: 关于你女儿……

English: Did you find her, mortal?
Chinese: 你找到她了吗，凡人？

English: I must admit, I have been watching your progress with interest. <<With a flick of her wrist, she creates a small, shimmering mirror. It seems to show you entering Cadaver Keep.>>
Chinese: 不得不承认，我一直饶有兴致地关注着你的进展。<<她手腕一抖，变出一面微光闪烁的小镜子。镜中似乎映出你走进尸骸要塞的情形。>>

English: But, my voyeurism spells couldn't penetrate the island above the keep, so I've been awaiting your return with baited breath...
Chinese: 不过，我的窥视法术穿不透要塞上方的那座岛，所以我一直屏息等着你回来……

English: I'm sorry, Duchess. It's not good news.
Chinese: 抱歉，女公爵。不是好消息。

English: <<She is suddenly deathly still.>> Was she... not there?
Chinese: <<她突然僵住。>>她……不在那里？

English: I have her hand. Nothing more.
Chinese: 我拿到了她的手。仅此而已。

English: <<You present the hand to the Duchess. A beaming smile spreads across the Duchess' face.>>
Chinese: <<你把那只手呈给女公爵。一抹灿烂的笑容在她脸上绽开。>>

English: Ah, my Ellyn, you are returned to me at last! ##<<The Duchess tenderly presses the hand against her face. Ellyn's hand seems to respond in kind, relaxing and stroking her mothers' cheek.>>
Chinese: 啊，我的艾琳，你终于回到我身边了！##<<女公爵把那只手温柔地贴上自己的脸。艾琳的手似乎也温顺地回应着，舒展开来，轻抚着母亲的面颊。>>

English: Uh, you were ((expecting)) this?
Chinese: 呃，你((料到))会这样？

English: Apologies, mortal, did I forget to mention? All that remains of my daughter is her hand.
Chinese: 抱歉，凡人，我没提过吗？我女儿留下的只有这只手。

English: Where's the rest of your daughter?
Chinese: 你女儿的其他部分呢？

English: The rest of her was lost, many centuries ago. Where? I cannot say - but it is not an uncommon fate for my kind.
Chinese: 她的其余部分，许多个世纪前就失落了。在哪？我无从知晓——但对我族人而言，这命途并不罕见。

English: It is very hard to truly ((kill)) an Endless. But that does not mean our bodies can't be broken. Severed. ((Seperated.)) Many of my kind rest not in peace, but in pieces - scattered around the realm like fallen leaves.
Chinese: 要真正((杀死))一个无尽者非常困难。但这不代表我们的身体不会破碎。断离。((分散。))我的许多同类不得安眠，只能身首异处——像落叶一样散落王国各处。

English: I lost Ellyn to this abhorrent fate some three hundred years ago. <<She touches the hand, gently.>> ##I have long accepted that I will never see her face again.
Chinese: 大约三百年前，艾琳就落入了这可憎的命运。<<她轻抚那只手。>>##我早已接受，此生再也见不到她的脸。

English: But she is not ((dead.)) She is conscious, and she ((knows)) the touch of her mother. So what more can I do, but be there for her?
Chinese: 但她没有((死。))她仍有意识，她((认得))母亲的抚摸。那我除了守着她，还能做什么呢？

English: That's... touching.
Chinese: 真是……感人。

English: That's... horrible.
Chinese: 真是……可怕。

English: <<She sighs.>> It is, of course, not a fate I would have chosen for my daughter. I often wonder if it would be kinder for her to be... ((truly)) at peace.
Chinese: <<她叹了口气。>>当然，这不是我会为女儿选择的命运。我常常想，让她……((真正))安息，会不会更仁慈一些。

English: I suppose that's why I followed Vela for so long. For good or ill, she promised ((change)).
Chinese: 或许正因如此，我才追随了薇拉那么久。无论福祸，她许诺了((改变))。

English: With Vela, you could grant the Endless a true death.
Chinese: 跟着薇拉，你可以让无尽者迎来真正的死亡。

English: <<She strokes her daughter's hand.>> Perhaps you are right. Perhaps my kind has lingered in wretchedness for too long.
Chinese: <<她轻抚女儿的手。>>也许你说得对。也许我的族人已在凄苦中滞留了太久。

English: <<She closes her eyes.>> This is no life. We are but ghosts, who cling to fading dreams. I do not wish this for my daughter.
Chinese: <<她闭上眼睛。>>这算什么活着。我们不过是死抱着褪色残梦的幽魂。我不愿女儿也这样。

English: With Vela, you could make the Endless truly immortal.
Chinese: 跟着薇拉，你可以让无尽者获得真正的不朽。

English: <<She strokes her daughter's hand.>> Perhaps you are right. I should fight for a ((better)) life for my daughter, so she can feel the wind on her face once more...
Chinese: <<她轻抚女儿的手。>>也许你说得对。我应该为女儿争取((更好))的生活，让她能再次感受拂面的清风……

English: Vela meddles with powers beyond her control; we must learn to accept our fate.
Chinese: 薇拉在玩弄她驾驭不了的力量；我们必须学会接受命运。

English: <<She strokes her daughter's hand.>> Perhaps you are right. This curse is our burden to bear. To risk utter catastrophe over some fool's hope? It would not be right.
Chinese: <<她轻抚女儿的手。>>也许你说得对。这道诅咒就是我们该背负的重担。为某个蠢货的痴念去赌一场万劫不复？那不对。

English: <<She is silent a moment.>> Thank you, mortal, for returning my daughter to me. I hope the whole ordeal wasn't too... troublesome.
Chinese: <<她沉默片刻。>>谢谢你，凡人，谢谢你还回我的女儿。希望这一路没有太……折腾你。

English: No, no trouble at all.
Chinese: 不，一点也不折腾。

English: That tower was pretty tall. There were a ((lot)) of ramps.
Chinese: 那座塔真够高的。坡道多得((很))。

English: <<She smiles.>> You're too modest, mortal. Don't think I hadn't noticed that missing finger of yours.
Chinese: <<她微笑。>>你太谦虚了，凡人。别以为我没注意到你少了一根手指。

English: Well, I ((did)) lose a finger.
Chinese: 呃，我((确实))丢了一根手指。

English: <<She smiles.>> I noticed, mortal.
Chinese: <<她微笑。>>我注意到了，凡人。

English: But, nothing a little cipher can't fix. Here, hold out your hand...
Chinese: 不过，再精巧的密文也治不了的东西可不多。来，把手伸出来……

English: <<The Duchess utters some harsh sounding consonants, and her voice seems to suck the warmth from the air. For a moment, your hand seems to burn with an unbearable heat.>>
Chinese: <<女公爵吐出一串刺耳的辅音，她的声音仿佛抽干了空气中的暖意。刹那间，你的手像是被难以忍受的灼热吞噬。>>

English: <<But when you look down at it, your missing digit has been replaced with a spectral finger. It glows and shimmers with unnatural colour, but is firm to the touch.>>
Chinese: <<但当你低头看去，缺失的手指已被一根幽灵手指取代。它泛着不自然的光泽、异样的色彩，摸上去却结实得很。>>

English: There we are, mortal. You may even find this to be an ((improvement)). Few can match my skill with cipher facsimiles.
Chinese: 好了，凡人。说不定你还会觉得这是个((升级))呢。论密文复制品的手艺，没几人比得过我。

English: And now, I will honour my side of the bargain. ##When I delved into your mind, I saw that you have captured the [[Blinding Light]], correct? I will make my way there, so we can plan our next move.
Chinese: 现在，该我履行我这一半的约定了。##方才翻你记忆时，我看到你已经拿下了[[炫光要塞]]，对吧？我会自行前往那里，我们再从长计议。

English: Farewell for now, mortal.
Chinese: 暂且别过，凡人。

English: Ah, it's good to be out in the skyrealms again! One can get frightfully bored spending eternity in dusty old tombs.
Chinese: 啊，重回天空领域的感觉真好！在积灰的旧坟墓里耗上永生永世，人是要闷坏的。

English: How are you settling in?
Chinese: 你住得还习惯吗？

English: I've just about finished transposing my collection of essential grimoires. Not a bad spot for them, eh?
Chinese: 我那批要紧的魔法书差不多都搬完了。这地方放它们不赖，嗯？

English: I must admit, it's exciting to see all these mortals scurrying around. There's an ((urgency)) to mortal life that's been lost to my kind. I realise now that, since giving up this life... I've missed it.
Chinese: 不得不承认，看着这些凡人四处奔忙，还挺让人振奋的。凡人的生命自有一种((紧迫感))，而我的族人早已失去。如今我才明白，自从舍弃那种生活……我一直很想念它。

English: I wanted to ask you something.
Chinese: 我想请教你些事。

English: Go ahead, mortal.
Chinese: 请问吧，凡人。

English: About the task at hand...
Chinese: 关于眼下的事……

English: <<She nods.>> I understand you're still looking for my former comrades?
Chinese: <<她点头。>>我知道你还在找我昔日的同伴们？

English: Well, you should start with [[Jack Basalt.]] You'll probably find that old seaslug in the nearest tavern - which I understand to be the [[Wobbly Noggin]] pub in [[Hallow Town.]]
Chinese: 嗯，你可以从[[杰克·巴索特]]入手。那头老海蛞蝓多半就泡在最近的酒馆里——据我所知是[[哈洛镇]]的[[摇晃酒馆]]。

English: Now, if you're looking for Vela, you'll need to track down Orlaith - or, as most folk call her, [[The Emberian.]] If anyone knows where Vela is, it's going to be her. ##Last I heard, she was hunting for Emberian ruins in [[Hallowshire]].
Chinese: 至于薇拉，你得先找到奥莱丝——大家伙都管她叫[[余烬人]]。要说谁最清楚薇拉的行踪，非她莫属。##据我上次听到的消息，她正在[[哈洛郡]]搜寻余烬遗迹。

English: If you're going to get this place up and running again, you're best bet is to find [[Caxton Frost]], one of the finest engineers I've ever known. I imagine he's back in the [[Clockwork Kingdom.]]
Chinese: 想让这地方重新运转起来，你最好的选择是找到[[卡克斯顿·弗罗斯特]]，我所认识的最出色的工程师之一。我猜他回[[发条王国]]了。

English: About your past...
Chinese: 关于你的过去……

English: There's quite a lot of it. What do you want to know?
Chinese: 我的过去可长着呢。你想听哪段？

English: Tell me again about the Great Devouring.
Chinese: 再给我讲讲大吞噬吧。

English: Tell me of your time as a Dark Star merc.
Chinese: 讲讲你当黑星佣兵的那段日子吧。

English: Well, I've spent most of my pitiful existence trying to avoid my duties as a duchess. If you can, try to imagine ((six hundred years)) of etiquette and droll ceremony. It's enough to drive anyone to madness...
Chinese: 唉，我这可悲的一生大半都在躲着女公爵的职责。你可能的话，想象一下((六百年))的繁文缛节和滑稽仪式。谁受得了，非疯不可……

English: So I left my seat, my realm; my duties. I wandered the skyrealms, drifting through places beyond my imagining, until I fell into the company of an ambitious young mortal called ((Vela.))
Chinese: 于是我离开了席位、离开了领地；抛下职责。我流浪于天空领域，游历过超越想象的境地，直到我遇上一伙人，领头的是个野心勃勃的年轻凡人，名叫((薇拉))。

English: <<A thin smile spreads across her lips.>> ## You know, when I first joined them - I thought it would prove a trifling amusement to watch such an incongruous bunch of mortals get themselves killed...
Chinese: <<她唇边浮起一丝淡笑。>>##要知道，我刚加入他们时——只想看这么一群不伦不类的凡人怎么把自己作死，聊作消遣……

English: But oh, it turned out to be so much more. To be in the company of those Dark Stars was to be in the flow of constant ((change)). No longer was I rotting in a tomb, in adherence to tradition - every day we sent ripples through the world.
Chinese: 可呵，结果远不止于此。与那些黑星同行，就是置身于((变革))的洪流。我不再守着传统在坟墓里腐朽——我们每天都在世上掀起涟漪。

English: <<She sighs.>> And I even allowed myself to get swept up in her rhetoric. To believe that there could be... ((hope)), for myself and my kind...
Chinese: <<她叹了口气。>>我甚至任由自己被她的辞令卷走。去相信对我和我的族人而言，或许还有……((希望))……

English: But like all mortal endeavours, it couldn't last. Vela's flame began to flicker; her optimism gave way to fear and desperation. Eventually, Orlaith led the mutiny that tore the Dark Stars apart..
Chinese: 但凡人的事业终究难长久。薇拉的火焰开始摇曳；她的乐观被恐惧和绝望取代。最终，奥莱丝领导了一场哗变，把黑星撕了个粉碎……

English: Many of us scattered, after that. Personally I had no interest in loitering around the carcass of a once-great thing, so I returned home - to a more familiar pile of bones.
Chinese: 此后我们各奔东西。就我而言，我可没兴趣守着一具昔日辉煌的残骸打转，于是我回了家——回到一堆更眼熟的枯骨里。

English: What caused so many Dark Stars to leave?
Chinese: 是什么让那么多黑星离开的？

English: Well, it all started with that [[Godkiller contract.]] It was at the height of the Dark Stars' infamy, when all of the skyrealms seemed to whisper our names in hushed tones. We were contacted by a Riovan noble, who wanted us to assassinate a major [[god]]...
Chinese: 唉，一切都要从那份[[弑神契约]]说起。那时正是黑星恶名最盛的时候，整个天空领域似乎都在压低声音传颂我们的名字。一位里奥瓦贵族找上门来，要我们刺杀一位显赫的[[神]]……

English: Vela was excited. Such a feat would cement our reputation - but not everyone was happy.##The [[Wikkan]] - a senior Dark Star, and a ((very)) close friend to Vela - saw this as a betrayal of her own kind.
Chinese: 薇拉很兴奋。如此壮举足以奠定我们的名声——但并非人人都乐意。##[[维坎人]]——一位黑星元老，薇拉((交情极深))的挚友——视之为对自己同族的背叛。

English: Vela argued that, to be a Dark Star, we had to leave our former allegiances behind. The [[new world]] we were carving had no space for those old and bitter ideologies. But for the Wikkan, killing that god? It was too much. Too far. It was crossing a ((line.))
Chinese: 薇拉争辩道，要当黑星，就必须抛下昔日的效忠对象。我们正在开拓的[[新世界]]容不下那些陈腐苦涩的旧观念。可对维坎人来说，杀那位神？太过分了。太越界了。那是一条((底线。))

English: So when it came down to it - when we'd hunted that deity into a corner, and Vela was poised to make the killing blow - the Wikkan stood in her way.##In anger, Vela cast her down. I watched the Wikkan fall from the ship, down below the clouds...
Chinese: 于是在最后关头——当我们把那位神明逼入绝境、薇拉蓄势待发要给予致命一击时——维坎人挡在了她身前。##薇拉一怒之下将她击落。我眼睁睁看着维坎人从船上坠落，跌入云海之下……

English: And something changed, at that moment. Vela was wracked with a terrible guilt. She started taking more dangerous, more ((dubious)) jobs. And that's when her dreams became more radical, and she set her sights on that Emberian artefact...
Chinese: 而从那一刻起，有些东西变了。薇拉被可怕的负罪感啃噬。她开始接更危险、更((可疑))的活。也正是从那时起，她的梦想变得愈发激进，盯上了那件余烬造物……

English: That time, it was Orlaith - or rather, the Emberian - who took umbrage. She led many of us to mutiny against Vela. ##If you want to know more about it, you should ask ((her)).
Chinese: 而那一回，愤而离席的是奥莱丝——或者说，余烬人。她带着我们许多人哗变，反了薇拉。##想多了解那段事，你该去问((她))。

English: Okay, that's all I wanted to know.
Chinese: 好，我想知道的就是这些。

English: Was there anything else, mortal?
Chinese: 还有别的事吗，凡人？

English: How is your daughter?
Chinese: 你女儿还好吗？

English: <<She smiles.>> Doing just fine, thank you. The air is clearer here; she enjoys the breeze on her skin...
Chinese: <<她微笑。>>好得很，谢谢关心。这里的空气更清爽；她喜欢微风拂过皮肤的感觉……

English: I'll be going, then.
Chinese: 那我先走了。

English: Farewell, mortal.
Chinese: 别过，凡人。

English: <<She strokes Ellyn's hand.>> Though, if Vela's plan comes to fruition... I am still not decided on where my allegiances lie.
Chinese: <<她轻抚艾琳的手。>>不过，倘若薇拉的计划真的成功……我仍未决定要效忠于哪一边。

English: You have given me much to think about, mortal... ##But for now, you should take your leave. I will meet you at the [[Blinding Light.]]
Chinese: 你给了我许多值得思量的事，凡人……##不过眼下，你该告辞了。我们[[炫光要塞]]见。

English: <<The Endless lurks in the corner, keeping a watchful eye on the other patrons.>>
Chinese: <<那个无尽者潜伏在角落里，警惕地留意着其他客人。>>

English: Get lost, breather. You're not interested in what I'm sellin'.
Chinese: 滚开，呼吸者。我卖的东西你不会感兴趣。

English: I'm looking to enter Cadaver Keep. Heard I should speak to you.
Chinese: 我想进尸骸要塞。听说该来找你。

English: <<He stifles a laugh.>> A ((mortal)) asking to enter [[Cadaver Keep]], of their own free will? Well now I've seen it all.
Chinese: <<他憋着笑。>>一个((凡人))主动要求进[[尸骸要塞]]？啧，真是活久见。

English: You have heard the ((rumours)), breather? About what goes on in there? What goes on with... ((your)) kind?
Chinese: 你听过那些((传闻))吧，呼吸者？关于里面在干什么勾当？关于……((你们))这类生灵的勾当？

English: Of course.
Chinese: 当然。

English: Uh... what rumours?
Chinese: 呃……什么传闻？

English: <<He chuckles.>> Well, ((some)) folk say that the Cadavers still haven't lost their appetite for the thinkin' flesh. That, deep in Cadaver Keep, there's an illegal trade in [[sentient meat]], right under the Queen's nose...
Chinese: <<他咯咯笑。>>唉，((有些))人说尸骸派始终没戒掉对会思考血肉的胃口。说尸骸要塞深处有一桩[[有意识血肉]]的非法买卖，就发生在女王的眼皮底下……

English: <<He winks at you.>> But of course, it's all just nonsense. We follow the Queen's laws like everyone else.
Chinese: <<他朝你眨眨眼。>>不过嘛，这些全是一派胡言。我们跟大家一样遵纪守法，遵循女王的法律。

English: Even so, I can't just let you waltz into Cadaver Keep. Us Cadavers are a... ((private)) bunch, you have to understand.
Chinese: 即便如此，我也不能让你大摇大摆进尸骸要塞。我们尸骸派是……很((注重隐私))的一群人，你得体谅。

English: There must be something I can do to change your mind.
Chinese: 总有什么能让你改变主意吧。

English: <<He looks you up and down.>> Well, I suppose there might be ((one)) thing...
Chinese: <<他上下打量你。>>嗯，也许还真有((一样))……

English: A chunk of your flesh. Still warm, fresh from the bone. That would prove your loyalty.
Chinese: 你身上的一块肉。刚从骨头上下来、还热乎的那种。那才能证明你的忠诚。

English: My flesh? Are you insane?
Chinese: 我的肉？你疯了吗？

English: Well, ((you're)) the breather who's trying to enter a stronghold of known flesh-eaters. And, I'm not asking for much...
Chinese: 嘿，((你才是))那个想闯进食人族老巢的呼吸者。再说，我要得也不多……

English: Uh, what ((part)) of my flesh?
Chinese: 呃，要我((哪里))的肉？

English: Only a morsel. Shall we say... <<he licks his lips.>> A finger?
Chinese: 一小块就够。要不……<<他舔舔嘴唇。>>一根手指？

English: Okay, fine. Make it quick.
Chinese: 行，好吧。动作快点。

English: <<He unsheathes a very large knife.>> Oh, don't worry, it'll be over before you know it. Now, hold out your hand...
Chinese: <<他拔出一把很大的刀。>>哦，别担心，眨眼就完事。来，把手伸出来……

English: <<With one quick motion, he slices off your finger. Your hand sears with pain, but he quickly douses the stub with a foul-smelling potion and wraps your hand in a rag. >>
Chinese: <<他手起刀落，切下了你的手指。你的手痛得像火烧，但他迅速把恶臭的药水浇在断指上，用破布把你的手一裹。>>

English: This'll fetch a good price, for the right buyer. You've proven your worth an' then some, breather.
Chinese: 这玩意儿找对买主能卖个好价钱。你可真是超额证明了自己的诚意，呼吸者。

English: Here, take this [[key.]] It will unlock the lift at the top of Cadaver Keep, that'll take you to the island above. It's there you'll find the [[Duchesses' Daughter]].
Chinese: 喏，拿上这把[[钥匙]]。它能打开尸骸要塞顶部的电梯，送你到上方的岛。女公爵的[[女儿]]就在那里。

English: Uh, I never told you I was looking for her daughter.
Chinese: 呃，我从没说过我在找她女儿。

English: <<He grins.>> We have eyes and ears in many places, breather.
Chinese: <<他咧嘴一笑。>>我们的耳目遍布各处，呼吸者。

English: Thanks... I guess.
Chinese: 谢谢……大概吧。

English: Of course, that [[key]] does not grant safe passage through the keep. ((That's)) not part of the deal. The second you step into that stronghold? Y'er on your own.
Chinese: 当然，那把[[钥匙]]可保不了你在要塞里畅行无阻。((那))不在交易范围之内。你一踏进那座要塞？就全靠自己了。

English: So good luck, breather.
Chinese: 那么祝你好运，呼吸者。

English: I'm not giving you my flesh. Goodbye.
Chinese: 我的肉不给。再见。

English: Okay, forget it.
Chinese: 好吧，当我没说。

English: @@ Maybe I ((am)) interested in what you're selling.
Chinese: @@ 也许我((确实))对你卖的东西感兴趣。

English: %%<<He studies you a moment.>> Well, well... a mortal with a ((deviant)) appetite?
Chinese: %%<<他端详了你片刻。>>哟，哟……一个口味((异于常人))的凡人？

English: Alright listen up, 'cos I'll only say this once; and if you breathe a ((word)) of this to any of the Queen's lackeys, I'll see to it that ((you're)) next on the menu.
Chinese: 好了听着，这话我只说一遍；你要是敢向女王的任何走狗透漏半个((字))，我保证下一道菜就((是你))。

English: So. I'm a broker for sentient flesh. The ((thinkin')) stuff.
Chinese: 这么说吧。我是个有意识血肉的掮客。就是那种((会思考))的货。

English: Y'see, most Endless feed on Penitent Thaw's mindless meat. It's seen as more ((ethical)) than eating... ((your kind)). But I'll be damned if it doesn't taste like slop - so of course, there's a black market for the stuff.
Chinese: 你瞧，大多数无尽者吃忏悔者·索的无意识血肉。据说那比吃……((你们这类))要((合乎道德))。可那玩意儿吃起来跟泔水一个味，去他的——所以嘛，自然就有黑市了。

English: So, how about it, breather? Fancy a taste of your own kind?
Chinese: 那么，怎么样，呼吸者？想不想尝尝同类的味道？

English: Uh... actually, I've changed my mind.
Chinese: 呃……其实我改主意了。

English: That's disgusting. You're a monster!
Chinese: 太恶心了。你是个怪物！

English: <<He chuckles.>> Thought as much. But remember, breather - you say anything about this, and it'll be the ((last)) thing you say.
Chinese: <<他轻笑。>>我就知道。但记住了，呼吸者——这事你敢说出去，那就是你((最后))一句话。

English: && Trust me, mortal - your kind wouldn't be able to ((stomach)) my merch, and you'd go squealin' to every damn fool about it - which 'aint good for business. So get lost.
Chinese: && 相信我，凡人——你们这类人((咽不下))我的货，还会屁颠屁颠跑去跟每个该死的蠢货告状——那可不利于做生意。所以滚吧。

English: I'll be going.
Chinese: 我先走了。

English: <<The hand of an Endless lies upon the pillow, completely severed from above the wrist.>>
Chinese: <<一只无尽者的手躺在枕头上，从手腕上方齐齐斩断。>>

English: <<The hand bears a [[signet ring]] on one slender finger. There's no mistaking it; this is the hand of the Duchess' daughter, Ellyn.>>
Chinese: <<纤细的手指上戴着一枚[[印戒]]。错不了；这是女公爵的女儿，艾琳的手。>>

English: ((Take the hand.))
Chinese: ((拿起那只手。))

English: ((Leave.))
<<As you touch the hand it suddenly recoils, as if alive. For a moment you pause, and the hand shivers before you.>>
Chinese: <<你一碰到那只手，它猛地缩了一下，仿佛活物。你愣了一瞬，那只手在你面前瑟瑟发抖。>>

English: <<When you finally pluck up the courage to pick it up, It writhes as you place it with your belongings.>>
Chinese: <<当你终于鼓起勇气把它捡起来，放进行囊时，它扭动了一下。>>

English: <<Ellyn's hand gently moves as you approach. You think she looks content - though admittedly, you know very little of sentient hands.>>
Chinese: <<你走近时，艾琳的手轻轻动了动。你猜她看上去很满足——不过说实话，你对有意识的手了解甚少。>>

English: <<You 've already taken the hand.>>
Chinese: <<你已经拿走那只手了。>>

English: Drat. Blast. Sugar. Blinking, blooming, flipping, f-f-f-f-((fudge)).
Chinese: 见鬼。该死。天呐。明明、偏偏、通通，去去去去……((去他的))。

English: Still having trouble cursing?
Chinese: 骂人还是不行？

English: Alas, I fear the muse of filth has forsaken me for good.
Chinese: 唉，恐怕脏话缪斯女神已经永远离我而去了。

English: Say it with me: Cunt. Cuh-unt.
Chinese: 跟我念：操。初——操。

English: Cuh.... cuh... ((cummerbund)). Ugh, this is just undignified.
Chinese: 初……初……((束腰带))。呸，太不成体统了。

English: Maybe this is good for you? It'll force you to get creative.
Chinese: 也许这样对你有好处？能逼你发挥创造力。

English: Oh, go and gargle your own urine.
Chinese: 哦，滚去用自己的尿漱口吧。

English: Do you have some purpose for bothering me? As I said, restoring this mountain of rust to its proper glory is keeping me rather busy.
Chinese: 你打扰我是有什么事吗？我说过，把这座锈山修复到它应有的辉煌，已经够我忙的了。

English: But enough of that. Are you bothering me for a purpose? Or do you truly value your time so cheaply as to spend it on ((blooming)) chit-chat?
Chinese: 闲话少说。你打扰我到底有事没事？还是说你的时间真这么不值钱，舍得浪费在((无聊))的闲扯上？

English: <<Frost scowls.>> I wouldn't go that far. Will that be all?
Chinese: <<弗罗斯特皱眉。>>倒也不至于。还有别的事吗？

English: Good. Will that be all?
Chinese: 很好。还有别的事吗？

English: Will that be all?
Chinese: 还有别的事吗？

English: I wanted to see how you're settling in.
Chinese: 我想看看你住得习不习惯。

English: Oh, like a louse to an armpit. Who the ((fluff)) do you imagine restored this fortress in the first place?
Chinese: 哦，像虱子住进腋窝一样自在。你以为这要塞当初是谁((他妈))修好的？

English: Given my abrupt departure from the Dark Stars, I suppose it's nice to be finishing the job. If only these ((dashed)) Union cretins would stop trying to 'assist' me.
Chinese: 想当初我仓促脱离黑星，如今能把这活干完，倒也算圆满。只要这群((讨厌的))联盟蠢货肯别来'帮'我忙就更好了。

English: As it happens, my father helped build these monsters back in the God War. The wooden parts are Lundelese, but the guns, plumbing, and nearly everything metal was made in Kardova. He used to put me to sleep by reciting components and assembly procedures.
Chinese: 巧了，神之战那会儿，我父亲就参与建造过这些怪物。木质部件产自伦德尔，但火炮、管路，几乎一切金属构件都出自卡尔多瓦。他从前给我念部件清单和装配流程催眠。

English: That explains a lot.
Chinese: 难怪呢。

English: Touche.
Chinese: 说得对。

English: So this fortress was made in the Clockwork Kingdom?
Chinese: 所以这座要塞是发条王国造的？

English: Correct, although back then it was called the Kardovan Republic. Somewhere in the guts of this thing there'll be a nameplate: "Laid down in such and such a year, Progress, Kardova. No gods, no masters."
Chinese: 没错，虽然那会儿它还叫卡尔多瓦共和国。这东西的内脏某处会有一块铭牌：某某年于卡尔多瓦·进步城铺设龙骨。没有神，也没有主人。

English: Funny how that one turned out.
Chinese: 这话后来应验得真讽刺。

English: Well, I'm glad you're feeling at home.
Chinese: 嗯，很高兴你有宾至如归的感觉。

English: I wanted to ask you about something.
Chinese: 我想请教你些事。

English: This clockwork exoskeleton is new. It helps you walk?
Chinese: 这副发条外骨骼挺新的。是帮你走路的？

English: My, how observant you are. In fact, ambulatory support is merely one of its functions. The first incarnation was rather less powerful; but, to be fair, I was rather smaller.
Chinese: 哎呀，你观察得真仔细。其实行走辅助不过是它的功能之一。初代没这么强大——不过公平地说，那时候我也小得多。

English: I expect you want the whole story? After all, it is so very ((inspirational.))
Chinese: 我猜你想听完整的故事？毕竟它如此((励志。))

English: Please, go on.
Chinese: 请讲。

English: You can skip it.
Chinese: 可以跳过。

English: I'll spare you the exhaustive history of my diverse ailments; suffice it to say that I was a sickly child. The only thing my physicians agreed upon was that I must submit completely to their humiliating 'remedies', no matter how painful or ineffective.
Chinese: 我就不细数我那一身病症的漫长历史了；长话短说，我是个体弱多病的孩子。我的医师们唯一的共识是：我必须完全服从他们那些羞辱人的'疗法'，无论多疼、多无效。

English: I disagreed, and in due course it proved that with a little technological cunning I could treat myself better than they could. Machines, you see, actually listen to what one tells them.
Chinese: 我不赞同，而后来的事实证明，凭一点技术上的小聪明，我把自己治得比他们治得好。要知道，机器是真正听话的——你对它说什么，它就做什么。

English: How people ((loved)) to hear that tale once I grew up. The Machinists loved it especially. Come to the Clockwork Kingdom, where even a low-born invalid can travel the skies and be garlanded as a champion of the realm!
Chinese: 我长大后，人们((多爱))听这段故事啊。机械师们尤其爱听。来发条王国吧——在这里，连出身低微的病残之人都能翱翔天际，还被冠以国之名将的桂冠！

English: True, I was dogged and ingenious. But to what purpose? Yes, I improved my capabilities; but for whose benefit? Certainly I accomplished great things. But for whom? Myself? ##<<He sneers.>> What a cosy thought.
Chinese: 不错，我确实执着而机巧。可为了什么？没错，我提升了自己的能力；可造福了谁？我确实成就了大事。可为了谁？为了我自己？##<<他冷笑。>>想得倒美。

English: Sometimes I almost wish I hadn't bothered. At least then I wouldn't have been so ((useful)).
Chinese: 有时我几乎希望自己当初没折腾。至少那样，我就不会这么((有用))了。

English: That's all. Good luck with the fortress.
Chinese: 就这些。要塞修复顺利。

English: Luck is for amateurs, my dear.
Chinese: 运气是外行才需要的东西，亲爱的。

English: <<Just as you're turning away, there is an awkward cough.>> Actually, one moment, if you please? ##I wish to... that is, it behooves me... ((dash)) it all, let's not prevaricate about the bush.
Chinese: <<你正要转身，身后传来一声尴尬的咳嗽。>>其实，请稍等一下？##我想……就是说，我有必要……((见鬼))，咱们就别拐弯抹角了。

English: You were quite correct to scold me back in the Kingdom. The word for what I was doing is ((wallowing)). Specifically, in childish rage and self-pity.##<<He pauses, apparently unsure what to say next.>>
Chinese: 你在王国里骂我，骂得很对。我当时的状态，用词来说叫((自怨自艾))。具体而言，沉溺于孩子气的暴怒和自怜。##<<他顿住，显然不知下一句该说什么。>>

English: Is 'thank you' perhaps the phrase you're looking for?
Chinese: 你想找的词，该不会是"谢谢"吧？

English: ((Confound)) it, what else would I be trying to say? ((Bog)) off before I regret such wasteful sentimentality!
Chinese: ((该死))，不然我还想说什么？趁我没后悔这番浪费感情的煽情，快((滚))！

English: Don't mention it. We all have our bad days.
Chinese: 别放在心上。谁都有倒霉的日子。

English: Hrm. Yes, quite. Very good. ##Well, what are you waiting for? A medal? ((Bog)) off before you break something expensive.
Chinese: 哼。是，没错。很好。##那么，你还等什么？等颁奖章？趁你还没碰坏什么贵重东西，快((滚))。

English: Let's see if you can come up with a question I haven't heard before.
Chinese: 看看你能不能问出个我没听过的问题。

English: About the task at hand...
Chinese: 关于眼下的事……

English: Ah yes, the search for my erstwhile comrades. Or should I say my former targets? Either way, this reunion will be ((interesting))...
Chinese: 啊对，搜寻我昔日的同伴。还是说，我昔日的监视目标？不管怎样，这场重逢会((很有意思))……

English: [[Jack Basalt]] will have already calculated that his best chance to stop Vela is to collaborate with the Union. He's wanted in the Kingdom, and he has a phobia of the Endless, which means he is in Hallowshire - and most likely in the [[Wobbly Noggin]].
Chinese: [[杰克·巴索特]]应该已经盘算清楚了：想拦住薇拉，他最好的机会就是与联盟合作。他在王国是通缉犯，又怕无尽者怕得要死，也就是说他就在哈洛郡——多半泡在[[摇晃酒馆]]。

English: I see you've pressed old [[Jack Basalt]] back into active service. The poor fellow's currently avoiding me, which is adorable. Granted, we hardly parted on the best of terms, but at some point we'll need to have a little chat.
Chinese: 看来你把老[[杰克·巴索特]]重新征召入伍了。这可怜家伙现在躲着我呢，真可爱。诚然，我们当初闹得不太愉快，但找个时候我们得聊聊。

English: [[The Duchess]] is a devoted family woman, and was already bored to undeath of the Skyrealms when I knew her. Therefore I would guess she is back at her country pile in the [[Endless Realm]], doing nothing in particular.
Chinese: [[女公爵]]是个顾家的女人，我认识她那会儿，她就早对天空领域腻烦得不死不休了。所以我猜她回了[[无尽领域]]的乡下宅邸，无所事事。

English: Alas, I'd forgotten how much [[the Duchess]] infuriates me. What she calls 'magic' is merely the cant of a more primitive age. Reciting cipher spells from memory, for pity's sake! It's like carrying a cart on your shoulders after the invention of the wheel.
Chinese: 唉，我都忘了[[女公爵]]多让我来气。她所谓的'魔法'不过是更原始时代的行话。背诵密文法术，我的天！这就好比发明了车轮之后还用肩膀扛车。

English: [[The Emberian]] is an odd one. She confided in me once that she was trying to unravel some ancient mystery, though she wouldn't say what. Most of this archipelago's extant prelapsarian sites are in [[Hallowshire]]. Ergo, that is where you should look first.
Chinese: [[余烬人]]是个怪人。她曾向我吐露，她在试图解开某个古代谜团，但不肯说是哪个。这片群岛现存的天裂前遗迹大多在[[哈洛郡]]。因此，你该先去那里找。

English: I get on rather well with [[Orlaith]] - or [[the Emberian]], as you mustn't call her to her face. Initially we despised each other, but then we had an arm wrestle and everything was tickety-boo. Since I was too drunk to remember it, I choose to believe I won.
Chinese: 我和[[奥莱丝]]相处得相当融洽——不过[[余烬人]]这个称呼你千万别当她的面叫。起初我们互相看不顺眼，后来掰过一次手腕，从此一切安好。因为我喝得太多不记得结果了，所以我选择相信是我赢了。

English: About your past...
Chinese: 关于你的过去……

English: Actually, no further questions.
Chinese: 其实，没有别的问题了。

English: ((Nul points)) for novelty, I'm afraid. But at least you tried.
Chinese: 新意方面恐怕要给((零分))了。但至少你试过了。

English: Must we?
Chinese: 非问不可吗？

English: Now, was that really your best attempt at an original question? I think you can do better.
Chinese: 我说，这真是你原创提问的最高水准？我觉得你能做得更好。

English: Must you?
Chinese: 你非问不可？

English: What was your life like before joining Vela?
Chinese: 加入薇拉之前，你过着怎样的生活？

English: I was born and raised in [[Progress]], back when they still called it Istriksburg. My mother made ammunition, while my father toiled in the Fortress Works. It was dangerous, but far better than serfdom in Lundel. For the first time in history, my family was wealthier than dirt.
Chinese: 我在[[进步城]]出生长大，那时它还叫伊斯特里斯堡。我母亲制造弹药，我父亲在要塞工厂做工。虽然危险，却比伦德尔的农奴境遇好得多。历史上头一回，我们家的家当比泥土值钱。

English: You know, you really don't sound like a peasant.
Chinese: 你知道吗，你听起来真不像个庄稼人。

English: Nor would you, if your childhood tongue had been scoured out by your schoolmaster. ##The last time I saw my parents, we sounded like we came from different planets.
Chinese: 要是你童年的口音也被教书先生刮洗过，你也不会像。##我最后一次见父母时，我们说话像来自两个星球。

English: You hide your common origins very well.
Chinese: 你把寒微的出身藏得很好。

English: <<He smiles without mirth.>>##Horace Metcalfe was hardly the first of my disguises.
Chinese: <<他笑得毫无笑意。>>##霍勒斯·梅特卡夫可不是我的第一个伪装。

English: After the God War, I studied in Byonne. A scholarship, funded by the new Kardovan Republic. My Union classmates were scions of barons or wealthy merchants, and they tormented me frightfully. Yet ((I)) was punished merely for setting them ((lightly)) on fire.
Chinese: 神之战后，我在拜昂求学。奖学金是新生的卡尔多瓦共和国资助的。我的联盟同窗都是男爵或富商之后，他们把我折磨得够呛。可((我))不过是把他们((轻轻))烧了一下，竟要受罚。

English: There's no justice in this world.
Chinese: 这世上就没有公道。

English: At least you left them something to remember you by.
Chinese: 至少你给他们留了个念想。

English: All right, I think I've heard enough.
Chinese: 行，我听得够多了。

English: Indeed. Eventually my studies were cut short by Kardova's split from the Union, and I returned home to begin my archaeological career. Believe it or not, in those days I was more like Horace Metcalfe than the ruthless mercenary now before you.
Chinese: 的确。后来卡尔多瓦脱离联盟，我的学业就此中断，我回到家乡开始了考古生涯。信不信由你，那时的我更像霍勒斯·梅特卡夫，而不是你眼前这个冷酷的佣兵。

English: Unquestionably these were the best years of my life. I followed my curiosity to the edge of the sky, and even to the Underlands, winning great renown and no small compensation. Yet I always felt as if everything could be snatched away if I failed to deliver even once.
Chinese: 那无疑是我一生中最好的年月。我追随好奇心抵达天空的尽头，甚至深入地下之地，赢得盛名和可观的报酬。但我总感觉，只要有一次失手，一切都会被夺走。

English: Perhaps that is why I felt so much more at home among the outcasts, oddballs, and reprobates of the Dark Star Company.
Chinese: 或许正因如此，我才在黑星的那群弃儿、怪胎和浪子中间，觉得如此自在。

English: Tell me of your time as a Dark Star.
Chinese: 讲讲你当黑星的那段日子吧。

English: Where does one even begin? We fought. We caroused. We feasted, we starved. We loved and we despised. We hurt each other, then we nursed each other. We were family, with all the best and worst implied by such a word.
Chinese: 这从何说起呢？我们并肩作战。我们纵酒狂欢。我们大宴，我们也挨饿。我们相爱，也相轻。我们互相伤害，又互相照料。我们是一家人——这个词包含的最好与最坏，我们都占全了。

English: The Caxton Frost who stands before you is a product of those days. He had to be sharp. Ruthless. Avenge every insult threefold, lest others smell blood. I'm told I was actually the inspiration for the Cadish Rakehill stories, though I've never read them myself.
Chinese: 站在你面前的卡克斯顿·弗罗斯特，就是那些年月的产物。他必须敏锐。无情。每一句侮辱都要三倍奉还，免得被人闻到血腥味。据说卡迪什·雷克希尔那套小说的原型就是我本人，不过我自己一本都没读过。

English: Vela could tell it was a facade, but she was gracious or canny enough not to expose me in front of the crew. ##Except when she was ((truly)) angry. One minute she could make you feel like you were bathed in starlight; the next, like the basest of worms.
Chinese: 薇拉看得出那是张假面，但她要么出于风度、要么出于精明，从不在船员面前拆穿我。##除非她((真的))动了怒。前一分钟她还能让你觉得沐浴在星光里，下一分钟就让你觉得自己是最低贱的蠕虫。

English: Did she ever suspect you were a spy?
Chinese: 她怀疑过你是间谍吗？

English: I've often wondered. Certainly our expeditions contributed much to the Kingdom's progress. Sometimes I got the uncanny sense that she knew my real purpose, yet kept me around anyway.
Chinese: 我也常常纳闷。我们的探险确实为王国的进步贡献良多。有时我会有种诡异的直觉：她知道我真正的使命，却仍把我留在身边。

English: Why she would do so, I cannot say. Perhaps it was simply our shared fascination with the Emberians. ##She told me once that I reminded her of someone who had been dear to her, long ago. I never did find out who, though.
Chinese: 她为何这么做，我说不上来。也许只是因为我们同样痴迷于余烬人。##她曾告诉我，我让她想起很久以前一位对她很重要的人。至于是谁，我始终没能弄清。

English: How did you manage to maintain your persona?
Chinese: 你是怎么维持伪装身份的？

English: <<Frost snorts.>> Why, I'd been doing that all my life. The only difference now was the extra pay.
Chinese: <<弗罗斯特嗤了一声。>>嗬，我这一辈子都在干这个。唯一的区别是现在多了份薪水。

English: Actually, I have my suspicions that the Clockwork King may have helped. At the time I had no idea that Its Majesty could alter minds. But I do recall being surprised at how quickly I took to the role. Of course, I can prove nothing.
Chinese: 其实，我怀疑发条王可能帮了忙。当时我完全不知道国王陛下有改写心智的能力。但我确实记得，自己入戏之快连自己都吃惊。当然，我拿不出任何证据。

English: Let me ask you about something else.
Chinese: 换个话题问吧。

English: I still don't understand why you had to wipe your memory.
Chinese: 我还是不明白你为什么必须抹除自己的记忆。

English: <<Frost sighs.>> Frankly, I'm not completely sure myself. But consider what had led to that moment...
Chinese: <<弗罗斯特叹了口气。>>坦白说，我自己也不完全确定。但想想是什么把我们逼到那一步的……

English: Eight years undercover. Can you imagine what that's like? To be believable, you cannot merely pretend. One part of you must truly ((become)) the false self, while another watches from the outside, remembering your mission.
Chinese: 卧底八年。你能想象那是什么滋味吗？要想以假乱真，你不能只是假装。你必须有一部分真正((变成))那个假我，同时另一部分冷眼旁观，牢记自己的使命。

English: I knew that if I betrayed the Clockwork King, it would never stop hunting me. Yet I couldn't bear to live in deceit for one more day. Thus the inevitable conclusion: the best cover identity is one who doesn't even realise he's fake.
Chinese: 我知道，一旦背叛发条王，它对我的追捕就永无止境。可这样的欺骗生活，我一天也熬不下去了。于是便有了那个必然的结论：最好的伪装，是连自己都不知道自己是假的。

English: I haven't decided whether I like being Frost again. He used to feel like armour, and now he feels... confining. Still, he's indisputably the man for the job. And I must admit it's easier when I don't have to be two people at once.
Chinese: 我还没决定是否喜欢重新当回弗罗斯特。他从前像一副铠甲，如今却让人感觉……束缚。不过，这份活儿确实非他莫属。而且我必须承认，不用同时当两个人的时候，日子轻松多了。

English: I'd like to ask you about another topic entirely.
Chinese: 我想完全换个话题问你。
